items.name: Adamant Tooth
items.description: A single grinding tooth from an adamant-grinder, harder than any drill bit. A handful will outlast a mining rig.

items.name: Adamantite Bar
items.description: Legendary alloy of unmatched hardness. Nearly indestructible.

items.name: Adamantite Ore
items.description: Near-indestructible crystalline ore of unknown origin.

items.name: Adaptive Shield I
items.description: Adds 60 maximum shield points and 10% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Adaptive Shield II
items.description: Adds 120 maximum shield points and 20% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Adaptive Shield III
items.description: Adds 200 maximum shield points and 35% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Adrenaline Surge
items.description: +15% to all combat stats for 5 ticks. Powerful but brief.

items.name: Advanced Drone Bay
items.description: High-capacity drone bay with room for five drones and 80 bandwidth for simultaneous deployment.

items.name: Advanced Repair Kit
items.description: Professional repair kit, restores 150 hull.

items.name: Advanced Tow Rig
items.description: High-efficiency tow system for wreckage or one of your own smaller ships. Only 30% speed reduction while towing.

items.name: Afterburner Fuel
items.description: High-octane fuel for afterburners. +100% speed for 3 ticks.

items.name: Afterburner I
items.description: Increases ship speed.

items.name: Afterburner II
items.description: Enhanced thruster system.

items.name: Afterburner III
items.description: High-performance engine booster.

items.name: Air Recycler
items.description: Atmospheric processing system for extended missions.

items.name: Algae Wafer
items.description: Sheets of bioluminescent algae pressed thin and baked until they snap. Salty enough to sell the next round and bright enough to find in a dim bar — dockhands go through them by the bowl and glow faintly on the walk home.

items.name: Alloy Scale
items.description: A vanadium-alloyed shell plate shed by a cauldronback, harder than any foundry plate of the same thickness. Smiths call the alloy composition 'better than designed.'

items.name: Aluminum Ore
items.description: Lightweight metal ore for basic hull construction.

items.name: Aluminum Sheet
items.description: Lightweight structural panels for basic construction.

items.name: Ammo Fabricator
items.description: Automated system for producing ammunition from raw materials.

items.name: Ammonia Ice
items.description: Frozen ammonia used in industrial coolants and fertilizer.

items.name: Anchor Beacon
items.description: Deploys a fixed reference signal that improves scanning and surveying for 20 ticks.

items.name: Anchor Plate
items.description: A broad, titanium-laced shell plate shed by a magnet-barnacle. Light, strong, and already curved for hull work.

items.name: Anomaly Detector
items.description: Detects spatial anomalies and wormholes. When equipped, survey_system reveals wormhole locations and provides directional hints to nearby wormholes.

items.name: Anomaly Probe
items.description: Specialized probe that adds 60 anomaly-detection power for 10 ticks.

items.name: Antimatter Containment Cell
items.description: A trace amount of antimatter naturally occurring in deep asteroid formations, captured in a magnetic containment vessel. Too small to use directly — but enough to seed a larger reaction.

items.name: Antimatter-Core Rounds Box
items.description: Magnetically contained antimatter warheads packed in a shielded crate. Extreme damage with minor splash effect.

items.name: Antimatter Torpedoes
items.description: The most destructive single projectile in known space. Handle with extreme caution.

items.name: Antimatter Warhead
items.description: Single devastating antimatter warhead. The most destructive guided munition available.

items.name: Argon Condenser
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of argon gas into cargo. Use this to filter out argon while harvesting rarer gases. Chills the intake to −186°C so argon condenses to liquid and vents. High power draw.

items.name: Argon Gas
items.description: Inert gas for shielding during welding and manufacturing.

items.name: Armor-Buster Missiles
items.description: Shaped charge warheads designed to penetrate heavy armor plating.

items.name: Armor Piercing Rounds Box
items.description: Hardened penetrator tips packed in a sealed magazine. Bypasses armor plating on impact.

items.name: Armor Plate
items.description: Reinforced hull plating for heavy armor construction.

items.name: Armor Plate I
items.description: Adds 5 armor points and reduces speed by 1. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Armor Plate II
items.description: Adds 10 armor points and reduces speed by 1. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Armor Plate III
items.description: Adds 18 armor points and reduces speed by 2. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Armor Repairer I
items.description: While bracing in battle, restores 5 hull points per tick. Multiple copies add their repair rates.

items.name: Armor Repairer II
items.description: While bracing in battle, restores 12 hull points per tick. Multiple copies add their repair rates.

items.name: Armor Repairer III
items.description: While bracing in battle, restores 25 hull points per tick. Multiple copies add their repair rates.

items.name: Armor Weld
items.description: Quick armor repair paste. Restores 75 hull.

items.name: Atmospheric Processor
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of hydrogen, argon, and neon into cargo. Use this to filter out all three common atmospheric gases in a single module. Three separation stages run in series: combustion for hydrogen, cryogenic condensers for argon and neon. Very high power draw.

items.name: Atmospheric Unit
items.description: Pressurization and air-handling plant. Any facility where crew work or living cultures grow needs a breathable, regulated atmosphere.

items.name: Autocannon I
items.description: Rapid-fire kinetic weapon. Good against armor.

items.name: Autocannon II
items.description: Dual-barrel autocannon with improved fire rate.

items.name: Autopilot Core
items.description: Automated navigation and piloting computation unit.

items.name: Autopilot Module
items.description: Automated flight control for routine travel.

items.name: Ballast Plate
items.description: A dense, dull slab of lead sheet shed from a bulwark's back, already rolled flat and layered by the animal into effective radiation shielding. Cut and fitted, it is the cheapest way to line a hold, a reactor bay, or a hot-belt outpost against the rads — a ranch product, never recovered from a kill.

items.name: Barrel Assembly
items.description: Precision-machined weapon barrel for projectile weapons.

items.name: Basic Tow Rig
items.description: Attaches to ship wreckage — or one of your own smaller ships — for towing. Reduces ship speed by 50% while towing.

items.name: Bell-Jelly Bubbly
items.description: A featherlight sparkling wine aerated with bell-jelly levity bladders and noble condensate, so effervescent the bubbles lift the foam clean off the glass. The toast at every wedding the Federation throws.

items.name: Belt-Grazer Wellington
items.description: Grazer loin wrapped in gloomcap duxelles and a sunspindle-flour crust, baked until the pastry shatters. The showpiece a frontier cook trots out to prove the kitchen is more than a ration press.

items.name: Beltwheel Cheese
items.description: A firm wheel cultured from grazer milk, aged just long enough to earn a rind. Slices for a board, grates for a pan, and melts like it was engineered for it — the workhorse cheese of every station kitchen with a ranch connection.

items.name: Berserker Compound
items.description: +30% damage, -20% defense for 15 ticks. High risk, high reward.

items.name: Bioactive Compound
items.description: Processed xenobiological extract for advanced synthesis.

items.name: Biofiber Mesh
items.description: Living synthetic material that grows to repair damage.

items.name: Biogas Fizz
items.description: Crystal-melt water charged with crystallized biogas and a shot of fruit. A bright, aggressive soda that fizzes for an improbably long time. Kids love it; dentists across the Rim are quietly furious about it.

items.name: Bioluminescent Algae
items.description: Cultivated photosynthetic organisms. In the right medium they glow. Haven's luxury trade found a use for that.

items.name: Bioluminescent Culture
items.description: Cultivated light-producing organisms for sensor technology.

items.name: Blood Reaver
items.description: Deals 45 kinetic damage and repairs its user for 20% of damage dealt. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Breacher Torpedoes
items.description: Armor-piercing torpedoes with penetrating warheads. Designed for armored battleships.

items.name: Business Passenger Cabin
items.description: Private cabins with real beds, a galley, and a door that latches. Carries up to 6 business-class passengers who expect to arrive rested and will pay for the privilege.

items.name: Californium Neutron Source
items.description: A shielded californium capsule that provides a compact neutron source for advanced mineral analysis.

items.name: Capital Armor Plate
items.description: Massive reinforced plating for capital ships.

items.name: Capital Ship Frame
items.description: Structural framework for capital-class vessels.

items.name: Carbon Dioxide Ice
items.description: Dry ice used in atmospheric processing and refrigeration.

items.name: Carbon Fiber Weave
items.description: Strong, lightweight composite for hull reinforcement.

items.name: Carbon Ore
items.description: Versatile element used in composites and filtration systems.

items.name: Carbon Scrubber
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of carbon ore into cargo. Use this to filter out carbon while targeting rarer co-located resources. A reactive bed of hot oxidizers converts carbon to gas at the intake and vents it. High CPU load.

items.name: Cargo Bay Expansion
items.description: Modular kit to increase ship cargo capacity.

items.name: Cargo Container
items.description: Standardized storage module for general cargo.

items.name: Cargo Expander I
items.description: Increases cargo capacity.

items.name: Cargo Expander II
items.description: Optimized cargo storage.

items.name: Cargo Expander III
items.description: Maximum capacity cargo bay.

items.name: Cargo Superstructure
items.description: Modular cargo framework that maximizes volumetric efficiency within existing hull space.

items.name: Cascade EM Charge Pack
items.description: Chain-reaction charges that jump between nearby systems on hit.

items.name: Catalytic Scrubber Cartridge
items.description: A finned cartridge of platinum sponge that oxidizes carbon monoxide, methane, and trace volatiles out of recycled station air. Fouls in service — every life-support deck burns through them on a schedule.

items.name: Caustic Sac
items.description: A pressurized gland of concentrated chlorine compounds from a chlorophage. Etches hull plating clean — handle with care.

items.name: Caustic Sour Ale
items.description: A puckering sour ale soured with a controlled trace of chlorophage caustic sac. Bracingly tart, faintly dangerous, and fiercely fashionable in the trade-port taprooms that can source it.

items.name: Ceramite Plating
items.description: Heat-resistant ceramic-metal composite for plasma containment.

items.name: Charge Gland
items.description: An electrochemical organ from a lantern-slug, dense with biological capacitor plates charged by a lifetime of lithium intake. Handle carefully — a careless cut discharges the whole stack at once.

items.name: Chemical Liner
items.description: Corrosion-resistant tank and conduit lining. Lets a facility hold aggressive acids, etchants, and reactive gases without dissolving.

items.name: Chlorine Compound
items.description: Stabilized chlorine reagent for chemical synthesis and surface etching. Handle with extreme care.

items.name: Chlorine Gas
items.description: Toxic gas used in chemical synthesis and weapons.

items.name: Chromium Ore
items.description: Essential for creating stainless alloys and hardening steel.

items.name: Chromium Plate
items.description: Corrosion-resistant plating for harsh environments.

items.name: Cinderspice
items.description: A house seasoning cut with cinder-sylph ember gland for heat and a whisper of chlorophage sac for sourness. A pinch turns a slab of vatflesh curd into something a person might actually order twice.

items.name: Circuit Board
items.description: Integrated electronic processing boards.

items.name: Clarity Stim
items.description: Immune to electronic warfare for 5 ticks.

items.name: Cloaking Charge
items.description: Single-use cloaking field generator.

items.name: Cloaking Device I
items.description: Reduces scanner detection.

items.name: Cloaking Device II
items.description: Advanced stealth technology.

items.name: Cloaking Dust
items.description: Provides temporary stealth. +40 cloak strength for 5 ticks.

items.name: Cluster Missiles
items.description: Splits into multiple submunitions before impact. Maximum area coverage.

items.name: Cobalt Concentrate
items.description: High-purity cobalt leached from cobalt-squid ink, far richer than anything raw ore yields. Engine shops and armorers pay a premium for it.

items.name: Cobalt Cordial
items.description: A deep-blue non-alcoholic cordial coloured with a whisper of cobalt-squid ink and sweetened with fruit. Served long over ice. The mocktail the designated pilot orders and secretly prefers.

items.name: Cobalt Ink
items.description: Iridescent blue secretion wrung from a cobalt squid's ink sac, saturated with the cobalt it filters from the belts it grazes. Worthless from a starved shoal — only well-fed squid in cobalt-rich fields carry it. Refines into high-purity cobalt concentrate.

items.name: Cobalt Ink Risotto
items.description: Sunspindle simmered black-blue with cobalt-squid ink and finished with verdigris curd. Stains the teeth, thrills the table, and looks like a nebula on a plate. A Nebula Trade Federation signature.

items.name: Cobalt Ore
items.description: Heat-resistant ore used in engine components.

items.name: Cobalt Roe
items.description: Brilliant blue squid roe, harvested a few beads at a time from brood squid calm enough to let a rancher near the clutch. Pops cold and briny with a metallic finish — the most coveted garnish in Federation cuisine.

items.name: Cobalt Roe Blini
items.description: Warm sunspindle blini under a spoonful of cold cobalt roe and a swipe of verdigris curd — three bites of blue on white. The Federation's power-lunch order, priced accordingly.

items.name: Cobalt Squid Noodles
items.description: Hand-pulled sunspindle noodles slicked with cobalt ink and a fierce hit of cinderspice. Street food on every Federation dock — fast, cheap, and blue to the elbows.

items.name: Combat Drone
items.description: Autonomous attack drone with basic weapons.

items.name: Combat Drone Bay
items.description: Drone bay module providing capacity for three drones and 50 bandwidth for simultaneous deployment.

items.name: Combat Stim
items.description: Increases weapon damage by 10% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Communications Array
items.description: Long-range communication system for stations.

items.name: Compact Aluminum Smelter
items.description: A bolt-on press that passively smelts aluminum ore in the hold into structural sheet. A heavy fitting commitment for a single recipe — best as a stopgap when a refinery ship can't make the trip.

items.name: Compact Argon Purifier
items.description: A bolt-on separation column that passively purifies argon gas in the hold for welding and shield feedstock. Heavy CPU and power draw, one recipe only — a stopgap for field processing.

items.name: Compact Copper Wiring Plant
items.description: A bolt-on drawing mill that passively works copper ore in the hold into conductive wiring. Power-hungry and limited to this one recipe, but it lets any capable hull refine in the field without a refinery ship.

items.name: Compact Deuterium Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on isotope extractor that passively renders deuterium ice carried in the hold into fusion-grade deuterium. It runs only this recipe and is power-hungry — a partial substitute for a refinery ship, not a replacement.

items.name: Compact Helium Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on extraction loop that passively pulls helium-3 from helium ice carried in the hold. A fitting commitment for a single recipe — a stopgap when a refinery ship can't come along.

items.name: Compact Hydrogen Compressor
items.description: A bolt-on compression core that passively works raw hydrogen gas in the hold into fuel-grade liquid hydrogen. Power-hungry and limited to this one recipe, but it lets any capable hull process gas in the field.

items.name: Compact Lead Smelter
items.description: A bolt-on furnace that passively smelts lead ore in the hold into shielding ingots. Hungry for CPU and power and limited to this one recipe, but it brings refining to any hull that can spare the slots.

items.name: Compact Neon Ionizer
items.description: A bolt-on ionization cell that passively excites and contains neon gas carried in the hold. It runs only this recipe and is hungry for power, but it brings gas processing to any hull with slots to spare.

items.name: Compact Nitrogen Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on sublimation unit that passively works nitrogen ice in the hold into liquid nitrogen. Heavy CPU and power draw, one recipe only — partial field processing for any hull with the slots.

items.name: Compact Oxygen Liquefier
items.description: A bolt-on cryogenic loop that passively liquefies oxygen gas carried in the hold into propellant-grade liquid oxygen. A real fitting commitment for a single recipe — best when a refinery ship isn't an option.

items.name: Compact Steel Refinery
items.description: A bolt-on smelting furnace that passively refines iron ore carried in the hold into steel plates. It draws far more CPU and power than a refinery ship's integrated lines and runs only this one recipe — handy when hauling a dedicated refinery isn't practical.

items.name: Compact Titanium Refinery
items.description: A bolt-on smelter that passively refines titanium ore in the hold into ingots. It runs only this recipe and draws heavy CPU and power — a partial substitute for a refinery ship, not a replacement.

items.name: Compact Water Ice Processor
items.description: A bolt-on melt-and-filter unit that passively works water ice in the hold into purified water. Limited to this one recipe and a notable power draw, but it lets any capable hull process ice in the field.

items.name: Compact Xenon Extractor
items.description: A bolt-on purifier that passively refines xenon gas in the hold into propulsion-grade purified xenon. A partial substitute for a refinery ship's integrated lines — handy in edge cases, not a replacement.

items.name: Condensed Dark Matter
items.description: Stabilized dark matter for exotic drive systems.

items.name: Contained Antimatter
items.description: Magnetically confined antimatter for extreme energy applications.

items.name: Contained Enriched Uranium Rod
items.description: Lead-shielded container holding 2 enriched uranium rods. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Highly Enriched Uranium
items.description: Heavy lead cask containing one unit of highly enriched uranium. Significantly heavier than uncontained transport.

items.name: Contained Liquid Tritium
items.description: Cryogenic hazmat canister holding 3 units of liquid tritium. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Low Enriched Uranium
items.description: Shielded container holding 2 units of low-enriched uranium. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Processed Thorium
items.description: Hazmat container holding 3 units of processed thorium. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Reactor Fuel Assembly
items.description: Heavy shielded cask containing one reactor fuel assembly. Significantly heavier than uncontained transport.

items.name: Contained Reactor Grade Plutonium
items.description: Maximum-shielding containment cask for one unit of reactor-grade plutonium. Extremely heavy.

items.name: Contained Thorium Fuel Rod
items.description: Shielded container holding 2 thorium fuel rods. Safe for transport without special cargo modules.

items.name: Contained Uranium Hexafluoride
items.description: Hazmat container holding 3 units of uranium hexafluoride. Heavier than uncontained transport but requires no special ship equipment.

items.name: Contained Weapons Grade Plutonium
items.description: Maximum-shielding containment cask for one unit of weapons-grade plutonium. Controlled material.

items.name: Control Node
items.description: An automation and monitoring unit — wired sensors, relays, and logic that keep a production line running unattended.

items.name: Coolant Fluid
items.description: Processed thermal management compound.

items.name: Coolant Loop
items.description: A closed cryogenic circulation system. Industry runs hot; without one of these a smelter or reactor cooks itself.

items.name: Copper Ore
items.description: Conductive copper ore, essential for electronics.

items.name: Copper Piping
items.description: Drawn copper conduit and pressure pipe. The plumbing and wiring runs of any station module — coolant, power, and atmosphere all flow through it.

items.name: Copper Wiring
items.description: Bundled conductive wiring for electrical systems.

items.name: Corrosive Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Chemically enhanced plasma that eats through hull plating. Applies corrosion damage over time.

items.name: CPU Co-Processor
items.description: Adds additional CPU capacity.

items.name: Creature Carapace
items.description: Shed exoskeletal plating from a molting space grazer. Light and resilient — the outer surface is already UV-hardened from a life in vacuum.

items.name: Crimson Berserker Core
items.description: Combat computer that increases weapon damage as the ship takes hull damage.

items.name: Crimson Berserker Plating
items.description: Adds 25 armor and 60 maximum hull points. Each hit taken adds 5% outgoing damage, capped at +50% for the battle.

items.name: Crimson Bloodwine
items.description: Potent spirits brewed in the Fleet's forge-heated distilleries. An acquired taste — most species describe it as 'drinking a supernova.'

items.name: Crimson Iron Rations
items.description: Nutrient-dense military ration blocks produced at Ironhearth. No pretense of palatability. Extremely shelf-stable. The Fleet runs on these.

items.name: Crimson Ordnance Bay
items.description: Mass weapon deployment system with integrated ammunition fabrication.

items.name: Crimson Siege Plating
items.description: Fury-alloy reinforced armor designed to close distance under heavy fire.

items.name: Cryo Slug Case
items.description: Supercooled ceramic-jacketed slugs that flash-freeze hull sections on impact, causing brittle fractures.

items.name: Cryogenic Storage
items.description: Temperature-controlled container for biological samples.

items.name: Cryogenic Suspension Chamber
items.description: Sealed cryogenic suspension chamber for crew preservation.

items.name: Cryogenic Travel Pod
items.description: Suspended animation unit for long-duration travel.

items.name: Crystal Melt
items.description: A small clear crystal of near-pure water, deposited by a hollow pilgrim after filtering meltwater through its membrane stacks. Near-zero mineral content — the membrane does better filtration than most industrial processes.

items.name: Crystal-Melt Sorbet
items.description: Hollow-pilgrim crystal-melt churned with fruit and set with noble condensate for a clean effervescent finish. The purest cold thing you can put in your mouth — a palate cleanser the fine houses charge outrageously for.

items.name: Crystal Mining Probe
items.description: Specialized tool for extracting energy crystals.

items.name: Crystalline Lattice
items.description: Perfectly ordered crystal structure for energy systems.

items.name: Crystallized Biogas
items.description: Solidified metabolic gas vented by nebula-grazing fauna. Burns clean and bright.

items.name: Damage Control System
items.description: Adds 10% flat damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Dark Energy Cell
items.description: Contained dark energy for exotic propulsion systems.

items.name: Dark Matter Cell
items.description: Outer Rim dark matter suspended in a hydrogen-cooled containment cell. Provides extraordinary energy density for advanced power systems.

items.name: Dark Matter Projector
items.description: Deals 150 void damage, ignores 100% of typed resistance, and bypasses 100% of shields. Fires every 6 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Dark Matter Residue
items.description: Condensed dark matter found only in the deepest reaches of the Outer Rim.

items.name: Dark Matter Thruster
items.description: Exotic propulsion unit. Nobody's entirely sure how it works, but it hasn't exploded yet.

items.name: Darksteel Armor
items.description: Adds 35 armor points and reduces speed by 2. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Darksteel Ore
items.description: Impossibly dense ore that forms only under extreme gravitational compression — first identified in black hole accretion disks, now found wherever heat and pressure reach similar extremes.

items.name: Darksteel Plating
items.description: Processed darksteel for capital ship armor.

items.name: Deep Core Extractor II
items.description: Advanced rare ore extraction from dense asteroids.

items.name: Deep Core Extractor III
items.description: Elite mining system for the rarest materials in the galaxy.

items.name: Deep Core Extractor Mk I
items.description: A cross-empire hybrid drilling assembly that combines darksteel vibration dampening, null matter thermal absorption, sol alloy power regulation, phase crystal resonance immunity, and trade crystal targeting optics. Enables extraction of rare ores from deep core deposits.

items.name: Deep Core Survey Lens
items.description: A specialized optical component tuned to detect deep core mineral signatures. Essential for crafting advanced survey equipment. Awarded by the Deep Core Prospector quest chain.

items.name: Deep Core Survey Scanner
items.description: An advanced survey scanner specifically designed to detect deep core mineral deposits hidden within asteroid fields and nebulae. Crafted from rare components obtained through the Deep Core Prospector quest chain.

items.name: Deep Space Probe
items.description: Long-range probe that adds 50 system-survey power for 10 ticks.

items.name: Defense Platform
items.description: Automated weapons platform for station perimeter defense.

items.name: Defense Turret
items.description: Automated weapon emplacement for station defense.

items.name: Depleted Uranium Rounds Box
items.description: Ultra-dense penetrator rounds in a reinforced magazine. Extreme armor piercing at the cost of extra cargo weight.

items.name: Deuterium
items.description: Heavy hydrogen isotope for fusion power generation.

items.name: Deuterium Ice
items.description: Heavy water ice for advanced fusion reactors.

items.name: Dimensional Anchor
items.description: Prevents interdimensional displacement. Invaluable against exotic weapons.

items.name: Dispersal Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Wide-dispersal plasma cells that spread thermal damage across a larger area.

items.name: Docking Ring
items.description: Universal docking collar for ship berthing.

items.name: Driftkale
items.description: Crisp leaf and stalk raised on slow-drifting recirculation trays. Nobody's idea of a feast on its own, but every plate that isn't just meat owes it something.

items.name: Drone AI Core
items.description: Processing unit for autonomous drone behavior.

items.name: Drone Bay Module
items.description: Housing and control systems for combat drones.

items.name: Drone Chassis
items.description: Basic framework for autonomous drones.

items.name: Drone Command Module
items.description: Multi-drone coordination hub with parallel AI cores for swarm management.

items.name: Drone Comms Module
items.description: Encrypted communication system for drone control.

items.name: Drone Mining Laser
items.description: Compact mining beam for autonomous extraction drones.

items.name: Drone Repair Arm
items.description: Manipulator arm with welding and repair tools.

items.name: Drone Sensor Suite
items.description: Compact detection package for drone reconnaissance.

items.name: Drone Weapon Mount
items.description: Miniaturized weapon system for combat drones.

items.name: Durasteel Plate
items.description: Military-grade alloy combining steel with exotic elements.

items.name: ECM Jammer
items.description: Each fitted jammer independently has a 40% chance per battle tick to break your selected target's lock within reach 3. Multiple jammers roll independently: two give a 64% chance that at least one succeeds. The target can reacquire a lock on a later tick.

items.name: Economy Passenger Cabin
items.description: A block of cramped bunks and shared facilities. Carries up to 12 economy-class passengers — uncomfortable, profitable, and the backbone of every milk run on the lanes.

items.name: Electromagnetic Refinery
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of both iron ore and copper ore into cargo. Use this to filter out the two most common solid ore blockers in a single module. Combines magnetic separation for iron with a flotation cell for copper. High power and CPU draw.

items.name: Electrum Ingot
items.description: A gold-silver alloy prized for its balanced conductivity and corrosion resistance.

items.name: EM Charge Pack
items.description: Pack of standard electromagnetic disruption charges. One pack fully loads any EM weapon magazine.

items.name: EM Disruptor I
items.description: Deals 5 EM damage and applies a 10% outgoing-damage penalty for 2 ticks. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EM Hull Hardener
items.description: Adds 30% EM resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: EM Shield Hardener
items.description: Adds 25% EM resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: EM Smartbomb
items.description: Deals 30 EM damage. AOE radius 5 sends the primary hit's full post-defense damage as a new hit to every other enemy within ZoneDistance 5 of the target; each applies its own defenses.

items.name: Ember Gland
items.description: A still-smouldering organ from a cinder-sylph, where browsed plasma-gas is banked as heat. Sealed in a container it will burn at temperature for weeks; crack it open and it goes immediately.

items.name: Ember Marinara
items.description: A slow-simmered red sauce of crushed honeyglobe brightened with cinderspice, cooked down until it clings to the spoon. The heat builds late and stays. Every pizza line and noodle stall keeps a pot of it going.

items.name: Ember Spirit
items.description: Gloomshine redistilled over a cinder-sylph ember gland until it genuinely warms the throat going down. Crimson Fleet crews drink it before a boarding action. Everyone else drinks it to say they did.

items.name: Emergency Cloaking System
items.description: After surviving a hit that drops shields from above 0 to 0, activates a base-strength-60 cloak for 10 ticks and exits the battle. Effective cloak strength includes fitted cloak modules with diminishing returns, hull bonuses, and the pilot's Stealth skill. Cloaking consumes 1 fuel per tick and ends early without fuel.

items.name: Emergency Warp Device
items.description: Jury-rigged jump coil packed into a disposable casing. Rips a one-way hole to a random nearby system — no targeting, no guarantees. You'll arrive alive and somewhere else, which is usually enough. Usable in combat.

items.name: Emergency Warp Stabilizer
items.description: Dead man's switch for your hull. When damage would bring you below 20% integrity, this module fires a pre-charged jump coil that rips you straight home — hull stabilized, ship intact, module slag. One use. One defense slot. Worth every credit if it saves your capital ship.

items.name: EMP Cannon I
items.description: Deals 8 energy damage and disrupts the target for 2 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: EMP Mines
items.description: Electromagnetic pulse mines. Disrupts any ship that enters the blast zone.

items.name: EMP Missile Launcher
items.description: Deals 15 explosive damage and disrupts the target for 3 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: EMP Missiles
items.description: Electromagnetic pulse warheads. Disrupts all systems in the blast radius.

items.name: EMP Pulse I
items.description: Deals 5 EM damage and disrupts the target for 1 tick, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EMP Pulse II
items.description: Deals 10 EM damage and disrupts the target for 2 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EMP Pulse III
items.description: Deals 18 EM damage and disrupts the target for 3 ticks, imposing 100% speed and outgoing-damage penalties. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: EMP Slug Case
items.description: Slugs with embedded superconductor coils that generate an EMP burst on impact.

items.name: EMP-Tipped Rounds Box
items.description: Rounds with embedded micro-EMP charges. Each hit disrupts target electronics alongside kinetic damage.

items.name: EMP Torpedoes
items.description: Massive electromagnetic pulse. Cripples all ship systems for an extended duration.

items.name: Endurance Booster
items.description: Metabolic enhancer for sustained high-performance operations.

items.name: Energy Crystal
items.description: Naturally occurring crystals that store and amplify energy.

items.name: Energy Siphon
items.description: Drains enemy shields and transfers half of the stolen energy to your ship.

items.name: Engine Core
items.description: Propulsion system core assembly.

items.name: Enriched Uranium Rod
items.description: Low-enriched uranium fuel rod for civilian power reactors.

items.name: Entropic Void Core Pack
items.description: Entropy-accelerating cores that age materials on contact.

items.name: Entropy Beam
items.description: Deals 15 void damage, then immediately burns the target's hull for 10 damage on the hit tick and each of the next 4 ticks, bypassing shields and armor. Burns do not stack: active burns keep the higher per-tick damage and longer remaining duration. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Environmental Control Unit
items.description: Environmental control system for crew survival.

items.name: Escape Pod
items.description: Emergency evacuation vessel with minimal supplies.

items.name: Event Horizon Alloy
items.description: A shard of a Gorgonia's skeleton — darksteel and fury-crystal fused under the tidal stress of a black hole's edge into a lattice that should not hold together and does. It is faintly warm, and faintly heavy in a direction that isn't down. There is exactly one place in known space it comes from, and only so much of the coral that grows it.

items.name: Event Horizon Plating
items.description: Adds 48 armor and 100 maximum hull points with no speed penalty. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Exotic Crystal
items.description: Rare crystalline structure with quantum properties.

items.name: Exotic Cyst
items.description: A sealed, faintly humming cyst an aeonbear walls off around the exotic matter it cannot digest — the strangeness held stable inside a husk of its own plating. Cracked in a stabilizer it yields usable stabilized exotic without the raw-matter danger. The rarest drop in the belt.

items.name: Exotic Distillate
items.description: A concentrated drop of exotic compounds filtered from nebula gas by a skeinwraith's living chromatography membrane. Each one represents a trillion passes of gas through living tissue.

items.name: Exotic Lattice
items.description: A self-organizing crystal lattice grown from the concentrated exotic matter of nebula fauna — phase-pearl, quantum-silk, and umbral residue fused in one frame. It hums with properties no ordinary alloy can match, and the best laboratories will pay almost anything for it.

items.name: Exotic Matter
items.description: Strange matter with properties that defy conventional physics. Found only in Voidborn space.

items.name: Expanded Fuel Tank
items.description: Additional pressurized fuel bladders bolted into previously empty hull space. Significantly increases fuel capacity, but the structural modifications reduce hull integrity.

items.name: Explosive Hull Hardener
items.description: Adds 30% explosive resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Explosive Shield Hardener
items.description: Adds 25% explosive resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Explosive Smartbomb
items.description: Deals 40 explosive damage. AOE radius 4 sends the primary hit's full post-defense damage as a new hit to every other enemy within ZoneDistance 4 of the target; each applies its own defenses.

items.name: Fermentation Culture
items.description: Active biological cultures from continuous-feed vats. What exactly is fermenting is a matter of philosophical debate in the Outer Rim.

items.name: Ferromanganese Billet
items.description: A carbon-reduced iron and manganese alloy used to harden structural metals.

items.name: Ferrous Nodule
items.description: A dense, magnetic pellet regurgitated by a slag-tortoise after a meal of iron-rich rock. The magnetism is biological — each one holds its field without any external charge.

items.name: Ferrous Slug Case
items.description: Case of standard dense iron slugs for railguns. One case fully loads any railgun magazine.

items.name: First-Class Passenger Suite
items.description: A handful of lavish staterooms with panoramic ports and absurd fare margins. Carries up to 3 first-class passengers — the kind whose safe arrival the empires actually notice.

items.name: Flak Cannon I
items.description: Deals 15 kinetic damage with +100% damage to drones. Fitted anti-missile ratings add but incoming missile damage reduction caps at 75%. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Flak Cannon II
items.description: Deals 28 kinetic damage with +150% damage to drones. Fitted anti-missile ratings add but incoming missile damage reduction caps at 75%. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Flak Cannon III
items.description: Deals 25 kinetic damage with +200% damage to drones. Fitted anti-missile ratings add but incoming missile damage reduction caps at 75%. Fires every tick at reach 3.

items.name: Flex Polymer
items.description: Flexible synthetic material for seals and cables.

items.name: Flotation Cell
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of copper ore into cargo. Use this to filter out copper while targeting rarer co-located resources. Reagents injected into the ore slurry cause copper minerals to bind to bubbles and vent. High CPU load.

items.name: Fluorine Etchant
items.description: Precisely concentrated hydrofluoric solution for nanoscale circuit etching and advanced material processing.

items.name: Fluorine Gas
items.description: Highly reactive gas for chemical etching and processing.

items.name: Focus Stim
items.description: Increases weapon accuracy by 20% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Focused Beam I
items.description: Deals 15 energy damage; 25% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Focused Beam II
items.description: Deals 25 energy damage; 40% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Focused Beam III
items.description: Deals 40 energy damage; 60% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Focused Crystal
items.description: Precision-cut energy crystals for weapon systems.

items.name: Focused EM Charge Pack
items.description: Concentrated EM bursts that overwhelm a single target system. Higher damage per charge.

items.name: Focused Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Tight-beam plasma cells with higher energy density. Superior single-target damage.

items.name: Foil Scale
items.description: A bright shed scale from a mirror-skate's back, thin as foil and nearly pure aluminum. The purity is biological — the skate pre-refines the metal as it deposits each scale.

items.name: Fragmentation Mines
items.description: Wider blast radius with shrapnel dispersal. Less direct damage.

items.name: Fragmentation Rounds Box
items.description: Pre-scored casings that shatter into lethal shrapnel. Devastating against drones and small targets.

items.name: Frontier Hash
items.description: Grazer meat, gloomcap mash, and driftkale all fried together on one griddle. The miner's breakfast, the salvager's dinner, and the only thing open at 0300 on most Outer Rim docks.

items.name: Frontier Rotgut
items.description: Rough spirits distilled at the edge of nowhere. The recipe varies by batch, but the hangover is consistent. Inexplicably popular at Haven.

items.name: Frontier Spore Spirits
items.description: Distilled from fungal cultures that may or may not be earth-origin. The Frontier Council has declined to investigate.

items.name: Frontier Survival Kit
items.description: Self-repair and life support package cobbled from whatever was on hand. Surprisingly effective.

items.name: Frostmoth Frappe
items.description: Crystal-melt and fruit blended with a lick of whale blubber into a thick, ice-cold frappe. A dessert pretending to be a drink, and not fooling anyone who orders a second.

items.name: Fuel
items.description: Station fuel. Not carried in cargo — sold directly from your ship's fuel tank via the 'sell' command. Stations post buy orders for fuel they need; factions can also post buy orders to fill their private fuel reserves.

items.name: Fuel Cell
items.description: Standard fuel cell, restores 20 fuel.

items.name: Fuel Optimizer
items.description: Reduces fuel consumption by 15%.

items.name: Fuel Tank
items.description: Standard fuel storage container.

items.name: Fury Alloy
items.description: Heat-storing alloy that enhances thermal weapons.

items.name: Fury Cannon
items.description: Deals 70 kinetic damage, increased by the user's missing-hull percentage. At 40% hull it deals +60%. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Fury Crystal
items.description: Superheated crystals from Crimson volcanic worlds, pulsing with thermal energy.

items.name: Fury-Tempered Plating
items.description: Crimson fury alloy layered with steel under extreme heat. The resulting armor plate resists both kinetic and energy weapons.

items.name: Fusion Fuel Rod
items.description: Processed deuterium-tritium fuel for reactor cores.

items.name: Fusion Pearl
items.description: A glassy bead of compacted deuterium, layered like a pearl in a deuteron-slug's mantle. A clean, ready-made fusion charge.

items.name: Galactic Standard Alloy
items.description: Solarian composite fused with Crimson fury alloy and steel. The resulting material meets universal shipbuilding standards across all five empires.

items.name: Gas Harvester I
items.description: Collects valuable gases from nebulae and gas clouds.

items.name: Gas Harvester II
items.description: Improved gas collection with better containment.

items.name: Gas Harvester III
items.description: Industrial gas collection system.

items.name: Gas Harvester IV
items.description: Capital-grade gas collection and compression system.

items.name: Ghost Rounds
items.description: Ammunition manufactured without serial markings, energy signatures, or any identifiable trace. Built from bootleg power cells and titanium ingots in unlicensed armories. When forensics pulls these from a hull, the report just says 'unknown ordnance.' That's the point.

items.name: Gilded Chitin
items.description: Shed shell from a glitterback crab, so threaded with the gold it browses that it is worth melting down on its own.

items.name: Glintfin Fillet
items.description: Translucent, faintly metallic fillets cut from farmed glintfin, firm and clean-tasting with a mineral brightness on the finish. The galaxy's first real fish — cooks who trained on nothing but xeno-meat and crab treat a crate of it like contraband. Harvested from a ranch, never a kill.

items.name: Glintfin Sashimi
items.description: Raw glintfin sliced paper-thin across the grain and fanned over crushed ice with a caustic-sharp condiment and ribboned driftkale. Eating something raw that isn't a dare barely exists out here — which is exactly why the raw bars charge what they do for it.

items.name: Gloomcap Mash
items.description: Dense gloomcap fungus cultured in the dark on nitrogen and damp, then mashed to a thick pulp. Meaty, earthy, and faintly alarming to watch grow — but it fries up like the best mushroom a planet ever produced, and it never stops.

items.name: Gloomshine
items.description: Gloomcap mash run through a station still until it comes off clear. Every backwater station has a batch working somewhere in the dark. Cheap, potent, and — when the good stuff runs out — the only thing on the bar.

items.name: Gold Bar
items.description: A mirror-bright ingot of refined gold, stamped and assayed. It powers nothing and builds nothing — it simply is worth a great deal, and always will be.

items.name: Gold Ore
items.description: Highly conductive precious metal for advanced electronics.

items.name: Gold Wiring
items.description: Premium conductive material for sensitive electronics.

items.name: Grand Dining Hall
items.description: A full sit-down restaurant with a working kitchen brigade and a wine list, the centerpiece of any serious liner. High covers per seating and a bar besides — but it eats provisions fast, so keep the hold stocked with dishes and drink.

items.name: Graphene Sheet
items.description: Single-atom carbon layer with incredible strength.

items.name: Graphene Thread
items.description: A spool of natural graphene thread extruded by an inkwyrm from digested carbon ore. Each strand is a single-atom carbon sheet drawn impossibly long — the worm does in a day what a laboratory does in a year.

items.name: Graviton Beam I
items.description: Deals 32 kinetic damage and deals 25% more while the target's shields are down. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Graviton Beam II
items.description: Deals 50 kinetic damage and deals 50% more while the target's shields are down. Within reach 4, gives its selected target a 30% escape-speed penalty; penalties add and cap at 75%. Fires every 3 ticks.

items.name: Gravity Generator
items.description: Artificial gravity system for stations and large ships.

items.name: Grazer Milk
items.description: Pale, mineral-rich milk drawn from a tended belt-grazer herd. Faintly metallic on the tongue and dense with iron-fed fats — it sets into curd almost eagerly. No wild grazer has ever surrendered a drop of it.

items.name: Grazer Milkshake
items.description: Grazer milk blended thick over crystal-melt ice with a heavy pour of honeyglobe syrup, served in a tall cup with a spoon-straw that mostly loses the fight. The official drink of ordering a pizza and not thinking about your next haul.

items.name: Grazer Steak Frites
items.description: A slab of grazer steak, greens fried crisp in whale oil, and no pretension whatsoever. The plate a spacer orders when they're tired of deciding — it's never once been a mistake.

items.name: Gutter Flux
items.description: A viscous chemical paste synthesized from industrial solvents and chlorine compounds. The name comes from the drainage channels where the first batches were cooked. Serves as a precursor for most illicit pharmaceuticals in the outer systems.

items.name: Habitation Module
items.description: Living quarters unit for station crew.

items.name: Hangar Bay Module
items.description: Enclosed bay for ship storage and maintenance.

items.name: Hazmat Container
items.description: Shielded container for radioactive or dangerous materials.

items.name: Heat Sink
items.description: Thermal management component for weapons and engines.

items.name: Heavy Mass Driver
items.description: Deals 120 kinetic damage; 80% bypasses armor and damage gains 50% while the target has no shields. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Heavy Pulse Laser
items.description: Capital-class energy weapon with devastating output.

items.name: Heavy Torpedo
items.description: Slow but devastating capital ship killer.

items.name: Helium-3
items.description: Rare helium isotope for aneutronic fusion reactors.

items.name: Helium Ice
items.description: Frozen helium-3 from gas giant atmospheres. Premium fusion fuel.

items.name: Highly Enriched Uranium
items.description: Uranium enriched above 90% U-235. Weapons-grade fissile material. Handle with extreme caution.

items.name: Hoarfrost Flank
items.description: Flank cut from a Hoarfrost Leviathan, flash-frozen the instant it leaves the body by the cold that pours off the beast. It arrives already cured — dark, firm, and needing nothing but a warm knife. Ice-field hunters prize it above the heartcore bounty.

items.name: Hoarfrost Flank Steak
items.description: Hoarfrost Leviathan flank, already cured by the cold it was cut from, seared hard and served blue with a bright ember rub. Ice-field hunters swear it's the only cut worth the frostbite — and the hoarfrost bounty barely covers the bar tab.

items.name: Hoarfrost Heartcore
items.description: The frozen cardiac node of a Hoarfrost Leviathan. Cold radiates from it for days after harvest — whatever process sustained the animal's temperature differential keeps running without the animal. Handle with insulated cargo.

items.name: Honeyglobe
items.description: A round, thin-skinned fruit engineered for pure sugar and shelf life over any resemblance to an ancestral species. The base of every dessert, cordial, and honest bottle of wine.

items.name: Honeyglobe Custard
items.description: Sift-ray yolk and grazer milk set into a trembling custard under a honeyglobe glaze torched to glass. The dessert a ranch station puts on the table to prove the whole dairy chain works.

items.name: Hot Cell
items.description: Jury-rigged power cells assembled from scavenged plasma conduits and stripped copper wiring. They run hot, they run unstable, and they're half the price of the legal alternative. Don't drop them.

items.name: Hull Integrity Field
items.description: Adds 10 armor and 80 maximum hull points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Hull Nanites
items.description: Nanobots that repair hull over time. Restores 20 hull/tick for 5 ticks.

items.name: Hull Patch
items.description: Emergency hull sealant. Restores 25 hull instantly.

items.name: Hull Plating
items.description: Reinforced armor section for ship construction.

items.name: Hull Reinforcement I
items.description: Adds 25 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 5. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Hull Reinforcement II
items.description: Adds 60 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 10. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Hull Reinforcement III
items.description: Adds 120 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 20. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Hydrogen Combustor
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of hydrogen gas into cargo. Use this to filter out hydrogen while harvesting rarer gases. A plasma torch at the intake ignites and expels it on contact. High power draw.

items.name: Hydrogen Gas
items.description: Basic fuel source harvested from gas giants and nebulae.

items.name: Hyper Mining Laser III
items.description: Industrial-grade mining laser with extreme extraction power.

items.name: Ice Harvester I
items.description: Extracts valuable ice from asteroid fields and comets.

items.name: Ice Harvester II
items.description: Enhanced ice mining with thermal extraction.

items.name: Ice Harvester III
items.description: Industrial-grade ice mining equipment.

items.name: Ice Harvester IV
items.description: Capital-grade cryo-extraction and processing system.

items.name: Incendiary Missiles
items.description: Thermite warheads that burn through hull after detonation. Less explosive force, more sustained damage.

items.name: Incendiary Rounds Box
items.description: Phosphorus-tipped rounds that ignite on impact. Causes sustained thermal damage to hull systems.

items.name: Inertial Gyroscope
items.description: Attitude stabilization system for precise maneuvering.

items.name: Ion Beam Array
items.description: Deals 30 energy damage and drains up to 20 capacitor on hit. Capacitor maximum equals Power Capacity. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Ion Blaster I
items.description: Deals 8 EM damage, +50% while shields remain, and drains up to 5 capacitor on hit. Capacitor maximum equals Power Capacity. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Ion Blaster II
items.description: Deals 14 EM damage, +75% while shields remain, and drains up to 10 capacitor on hit. Capacitor maximum equals Power Capacity. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Ion Blaster III
items.description: Deals 22 EM damage, +100% while shields remain, and drains up to 20 capacitor on hit. Capacitor maximum equals Power Capacity. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Ion Cannon I
items.description: Deals 12 energy damage and drains up to 5 capacitor on hit. Capacitor maximum equals Power Capacity. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Ion Cannon II
items.description: Deals 20 energy damage and drains up to 12 capacitor on hit. Capacitor maximum equals Power Capacity. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Ion Charge Pack
items.description: Heavy ion charges that drain capacitor banks and disable shield generators.

items.name: Ion Emitter
items.description: Ionized particle projector for energy weapon systems.

items.name: Ion Gas
items.description: Highly charged gas for ion propulsion systems.

items.name: Ion Nodule
items.description: A dense magnetic organ from a voltmanta, packed with ionized particle suspension. Removing it wrong discharges the whole thing. Done right, it is a ready vial of concentrated ion solution.

items.name: Ion Solution
items.description: Dense suspension of charged particles in magnetic containment. Essential for ion propulsion and directed energy systems.

items.name: Ion Sparkling Water
items.description: Crystal-melt water charged over a voltmanta ion nodule and noble condensate — a crisp electrolyte fizz that tastes faintly of a storm about to break. What the sober and the hungover both reach for.

items.name: Ionized Neon
items.description: Excited neon gas sealed in containment tubes. Emits characteristic orange-red glow used in sensor calibration and signal amplification.

items.name: Iridium Ore
items.description: Dense, corrosion-proof metal for high-stress components.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.description: Common ferrous ore, the backbone of basic construction.

items.name: Irradiated Marrow
items.description: Glowing marrow drawn from a geiger-hound's bones, saturated with the isotopes of its irradiated prey. A dense, dangerous power source.

items.name: Isotope Separator
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of water ice and nitrogen ice into cargo. Use this to filter out both common ice types and target only rare isotope ices. A dual-gradient thermal stack handles both in series.

items.name: Judgment Beam
items.description: Deals 100 energy damage with a 50% energy-damage bonus; 50% bypasses shields. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Jump Calculator
items.description: Advanced computation unit for jump drive calibration.

items.name: Jump Coil
items.description: Hyperspace transition mechanism.

items.name: Jump Drive Core
items.description: Essential component for hyperspace travel.

items.name: Jury-Rigged Cannon
items.description: Deals 60 kinetic damage with ±30% random variance and reduced CPU requirements. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Kinetic Hull Hardener
items.description: Adds 30% kinetic resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Kinetic Shield Hardener
items.description: Adds 25% kinetic resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Kinetic Smartbomb
items.description: Deals 35 kinetic damage. AOE radius 4 sends the primary hit's full post-defense damage as a new hit to every other enemy within ZoneDistance 4 of the target; each applies its own defenses.

items.name: Krypton Bladder
items.description: A bio-sealed chamber from a nullbubble, filled with pure krypton and stoppered by a biological membrane of near-optical quality. The membrane filters better than most industrial separators — what comes out is purer than what went in.

items.name: Krypton Gas
items.description: Rare noble gas for high-efficiency lighting systems.

items.name: Krypton Kvass
items.description: A lightly fermented sunspindle drink given an inert-gas lift from a nullbubble krypton bladder — barely alcoholic, weirdly refreshing, and vanishingly clear. The thing dockworkers drink by the litre in the heat of a reactor bay.

items.name: Laser Focus Array
items.description: Precision laser focusing assembly for mining equipment.

items.name: Laser Focusing Lens
items.description: Crystal optics for focusing energy weapons.

items.name: Lead Ingot
items.description: Smelted lead for radiation shielding applications.

items.name: Lead Lined Cargo I
items.description: A shielded cargo expansion that allows safe transport of refined radioactive materials.

items.name: Lead Lined Cargo II
items.description: Heavy-duty titanium-reinforced lead cargo bay for large volumes of radioactive freight.

items.name: Lead Ore
items.description: Dense metal used for radiation shielding and ballast.

items.name: Lead Sheet
items.description: Rolled lead plate. Primary material for radiation shielding equipment and hazmat containers.

items.name: Lead Shielding
items.description: Dense lead-lined plating. Bolted into the walls of any facility that handles fissile material or hard radiation — if you see it in the build, something hot is happening inside.

items.name: Legacy Ore
items.description: Pre-spacefaring Earth artifacts fused with asteroid material over millennia.

items.name: Leviathan Heartcore
items.description: The crystallized cardiac node of a Molt Leviathan. Still warm years after harvest — whatever metabolic process formed it continues without the animal.

items.name: Leviathan Heartcore Roast
items.description: A whole Molt Leviathan heartcore, still warm years after harvest, spice-crusted and set on the pass to finish cooking itself in front of the guests. Theatre and heresy in equal measure — served exactly once at the opening of a station worth opening. Ruinously extravagant.

items.name: Leviathan Meat
items.description: Sweet, pearl-white tail meat cut from a Molt Leviathan — the ship-sized space lobster of the deep belts. A single kill yields tonnes of it, enough to keep the galactic elite in bisque and tail thermidor for months. The rarest luxury protein there is, purely because the beast that carries it so rarely dies.

items.name: Leviathan Tail Thermidor
items.description: Molt Leviathan tail meat grilled in the shell, folded through a spiced curd gratin and finished under a flame. Richer and less fussy than the bisque — the dish a leviathan hunter orders to celebrate the kill that paid for their ship.

items.name: Levity Bladder
items.description: The hydrogen float-sac of a bell-jelly, still buoyant after harvest. Used to raise everything from balloons to ballast tanks.

items.name: Life Support Array
items.description: Extended environmental control system for long-duration missions.

items.name: Life Support Unit
items.description: Integrated air and water recycling system for habitation.

items.name: Light Drone Bay
items.description: Compact drone bay for carrier ships. Holds two drones with 25 deployment bandwidth. Designed for smaller hulls.

items.name: Liquid Ammonia
items.description: Pressurized anhydrous ammonia for fertilizer, industrial cooling, and chemical synthesis.

items.name: Liquid Hydrogen
items.description: Compressed hydrogen fuel for fusion reactors.

items.name: Liquid Methane
items.description: Purified cryogenic methane for fuel and chemical production.

items.name: Liquid Nitrogen
items.description: Cryogenic nitrogen for cooling systems and chemical synthesis.

items.name: Liquid Oxygen
items.description: Cryogenically liquefied oxygen for propellant use. Pairs with liquid hydrogen for high-efficiency combustion.

items.name: Liquid Tritium
items.description: Cryogenically liquefied tritium for fusion fuel applications. Radioactive and volatile.

items.name: Lithium Ore
items.description: Essential for energy storage systems and batteries.

items.name: Low-Enriched Uranium
items.description: Uranium enriched to 3-5% U-235. Suitable for reactor fuel assemblies.

items.name: Lumen Algae Salad
items.description: Ribbons of raw bioluminescent algae over driftkale, dressed tableside with split honeyglobe so the glow survives the trip from the galley. Order it on a dim promenade and the first course lights the second.

items.name: Lumen Honey Cake
items.description: A fruited sunspindle cake soaked in cloudwhale lumen oil so the whole thing glows softly from within. Served with the lights down; children and admirals are equally powerless against it.

items.name: Lumen Liqueur
items.description: Gloomshine steeped with cloudwhale lumen oil into a soft, sweet after-dinner glow — literally. Poured over crystal-melt ice at the good tables, where the lights come down to show it off.

items.name: Lumen Oil
items.description: Glowing oil rendered from a Cloudwhale's gas-straining glands, still lit with the neon it fed on. A drop of it shines for weeks. Refiners use it as a binder that sets baleen plate without cracking it.

items.name: Magnetic Ore Separator
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of iron ore into cargo. Use this to filter out iron while targeting rarer co-located resources. A high-powered electromagnet pulls ferrous material aside and vents it. High power draw.

items.name: Manganese Ore
items.description: Strengthening agent for steel and aluminum alloys.

items.name: Mantis Claw
items.description: The serrated forelimb of a crusher-mantis, strong enough to peel a grazer's shell like fruit. The serrations are biological — grown, not cut — and remain sharp without maintenance.

items.name: Mantis Claw Thermidor
items.description: Sweet crusher-mantis claw meat baked back into the shell with whale-blubber butter and a copper-tang verdigris curd. The Solarian admiralty's standing wardroom order, and the reason mantis-hunters never want for buyers.

items.name: Mass Driver
items.description: Deals 90 kinetic damage; 75% bypasses armor. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Medical Bay Module
items.description: Compact medical facility for crew treatment.

items.name: Memory Metal Sheet
items.description: Shape-memory alloy that returns to its original form after deformation.

items.name: Metallic Aerogel
items.description: Ultra-light solid with exceptional insulation properties.

items.name: Metamaterial Panel
items.description: Artificially structured material with impossible optical properties.

items.name: Methane Ice
items.description: Frozen methane for chemical processing and fuel synthesis.

items.name: Micro-Singularity Charge
items.description: A disposable, magnetically contained singularity seed for advanced void ammunition.

items.name: Micro-Thruster Array
items.description: Miniaturized propulsion system for drones and missiles.

items.name: Military Fuel Cell
items.description: Maximum density fuel, restores 100 fuel.

items.name: Mine Launcher I
items.description: Deals 50 explosive damage from a 5-mine magazine. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 60 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 60) per tick. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Mine Launcher II
items.description: Deals 80 explosive damage from a 10-mine magazine. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 120 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 120) per tick. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Mining Drone
items.description: Autonomous mining drone for ore extraction.

items.name: Mining Enhancer
items.description: +50% mining yield for 20 ticks.

items.name: Mining Laser I
items.description: Basic mining laser for ore extraction.

items.name: Mining Laser II
items.description: Improved mining laser with better yield.

items.name: Mining Laser III
items.description: Industrial mining laser.

items.name: Mining Laser IV
items.description: Industrial-grade mining system for maximum extraction.

items.name: Mining Laser V
items.description: Capital-grade mining system. Peak extraction performance.

items.name: Mining Survey Probe
items.description: Mineral detection probe that adds 30 system-survey power for 10 ticks.

items.name: Missile Guidance Unit
items.description: Smart targeting system for guided munitions.

items.name: Missile Launcher I
items.description: Basic missile launcher. Area damage.

items.name: Missile Launcher II
items.description: Multi-warhead missile system.

items.name: Missile Warhead
items.description: Explosive payload for missile systems.

items.name: Modulated Mining Laser
items.description: Precision mining laser whose fine-control emitters can work thin, depleted deposits that standard lasers disperse.

items.name: Molt Leviathan Bisque
items.description: The dish the whole trade exists to serve. Molt Leviathan tail simmered for a day in its own stock with whale blubber and crystal-melt, passed through silk until it's pure velvet. A single beast makes it for a season; the aristocracy of five empires books the table a year out. The undisputed benchmark of galactic fine dining.

items.name: Nanite Hull Coating
items.description: Adds 100 current and maximum hull points and repairs 10 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Nanite Swarm
items.description: Advanced repair nanobots. Restores 50 hull/tick for 5 ticks.

items.name: Nanocarbon Hull Lattice
items.description: Adds 250 maximum hull points and reduces cargo capacity by 30. Multiple copies add their effects.

items.name: Nanoplastic Composite
items.description: Self-healing plastic infused with nanomachines.

items.name: Navigation Array
items.description: Advanced astrogation system combining stellar cartography with predictive jump calculations.

items.name: Navigation Core
items.description: Astrogation computer for hyperspace calculations.

items.name: Nebula Bio-Regenerator
items.description: Adds 40 current and maximum hull points and repairs 8 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Nebula Cargo Matrix
items.description: Prism-lens enhanced storage system that optimizes packing efficiency through light-guided sorting.

items.name: Nebula Essence
items.description: Concentrated nebular gases with exotic chemical properties.

items.name: Nebula Fungus Tart
items.description: A savoury-sweet tart of gloomcap mash and honeyglobe over a verdigris-curd base. Sounds wrong, eats wonderfully — the pastry that made a Federation baker's name and started three imitators.

items.name: Nebula Gas
items.description: Complex mixture of exotic compounds found only in nebulae.

items.name: Nebula Prism Computer
items.description: Photonic processing unit using light refraction for massively parallel computation.

items.name: Nebula Stellar Vintage
items.description: A sparkling suspension grown in zero-g from luminescent algae cultures, filtered through trade crystal. Served on every gold-plated Nebula merchant ship.

items.name: Nebula Storm Barrier
items.description: Adds 80 maximum shield points and returns 15 EM damage after every hit. Multiple barriers add their retaliation damage.

items.name: Nebulium
items.description: Crystallized energy from the heart of nebulae in Nebula Federation territory.

items.name: Nebulium Core
items.description: Processed nebulium for advanced energy systems.

items.name: Neodymium Magnet
items.description: Powerful permanent magnet for electromagnetic systems.

items.name: Neodymium Ore
items.description: Rare earth element for creating powerful magnets.

items.name: Neon Gas
items.description: Bright noble gas for signage and laser medium.

items.name: Neon Signaling Array
items.description: Gas-discharge tube array for high-bandwidth sensor calibration and signal processing.

items.name: Neon Vent
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of neon gas into cargo. Use this to filter out neon while harvesting rarer gases. A differential pressure separator tuned to neon's condensation point liquefies it and vents it away.

items.name: Nerve Burn
items.description: A crystalline stimulant that hits the nervous system like a plasma arc. Users report a burning sensation that starts at the spine and spreads outward, followed by hyper-acute reflexes and a complete inability to feel pain. The crash is legendary.

items.name: Neural Accelerator
items.description: Reduces weapon cooldown by 20% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Neural Disruption Charge Pack
items.description: Charges tuned to interfere with AI processing cores. Extended effect duration.

items.name: Neural Disruptor
items.description: Deals 12 EM damage and applies a 25% outgoing-damage penalty for 2 ticks. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Neural Extract
items.description: Concentrated neural compounds for AI cores and stimulant production.

items.name: Neural Interface Gel
items.description: Biocompatible medium for brain-computer interfaces.

items.name: Neutronium Ingot
items.description: Stabilized neutron-degenerate matter. Impossibly dense.

items.name: Neutronium Slug Case
items.description: Impossibly dense neutronium-core slugs. The ultimate kinetic penetrator.

items.name: Nickel Billet
items.description: Smelted and cast nickel, the workhorse metal of battery electrodes and stainless alloys. Low-grade ore is concentrated heavily, so each billet represents a sizeable pile of raw nickel.

items.name: Nickel Ore
items.description: Corrosion-resistant ore used in alloy production.

items.name: Nitro Cold Brew
items.description: Cold-steeped gloomcap coffee charged from a pressblister nitrogen bladder into a cascading, velvet-headed pour. What keeps the night shift on the docks vertical. Do not have four.

items.name: Nitrogen Bladder
items.description: A pressurized biological sac from a pressblister, still sealed with cryogenic liquid nitrogen inside. Harvest it live and it stays sealed; crack it and you have your cryo feedstock.

items.name: Nitrogen Ice
items.description: Frozen nitrogen used in cooling systems and life support.

items.name: Nitrogen Vent
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of nitrogen ice into cargo. Use this to filter out nitrogen ice while targeting rarer isotope ices. A thermal gradient set between nitrogen's and water's sublimation points vaporizes nitrogen while leaving other ices frozen.

items.name: Noble Condensate
items.description: Liquefied noble gas, exhaled and concentrated by a halo-drifter feeding in xenon clouds. Burns an unearthly blue in thruster tests.

items.name: Noble-Gas Spritz
items.description: A dry fruit spritz aerated with halo-drifter noble condensate, so it prickles like champagne and never quite goes flat. The drink held at every dockside launch party that's pretending to be classier than it is.

items.name: Noble Matte
items.description: A dense, softly gleaming sponge of fused platinum-group metal prised from the chambers of a tended bullionaut, where the animal has already done the concentrating a refinery would otherwise sweat over. Drawn straight into superconductor without ever touching raw palladium. Ranch-harvested — a killed bullionaut keeps its matte.

items.name: Nuclear Mines
items.description: Tactical nuclear devices. Enormous blast radius. Indiscriminate.

items.name: Nuclear Reactor I
items.description: A compact fission reactor that dramatically increases ship power capacity.

items.name: Nuclear Reactor II
items.description: Industrial-scale fission reactor. Provides enormous power output for the most demanding module loadouts.

items.name: Null Cannon
items.description: Deals 110 void damage, bypassing shields, armor, and defensive reductions. AOE radius 2 sends that full post-defense damage as a new hit to every other enemy within ZoneDistance 2 of the target; each applies its own defenses.

items.name: Null Curd
items.description: A cold, dense paste of curdled null-matter drawn from a riftbloom's core, already condensed past what a processor would coax from raw ore. Heavy in the hand and strangely dark. Recovered from a hunted bloom.

items.name: Null Matter
items.description: Material that seems to absorb energy and light. Unique to Voidborn anomaly zones.

items.name: Null Void Core Pack
items.description: Cores that create localized null-space pockets. Devastating but difficult to manufacture.

items.name: Omega Core Pack
items.description: Mythical void cores of unknown origin. Their destructive mechanism defies conventional physics.

items.name: Onboard Galley
items.description: A compact ship's kitchen and mess that turns cargo provisions into hot meals on the move. Modest revenue, but it keeps a milk run's passengers fed and a little more patient about the trip. Consumes dishes (or drinks) from the hold while underway.

items.name: Onboard H2O2 Refinery
items.description: A self-contained electrolysis-and-combustion unit that passively converts water ice in the hold directly into tank fuel. It skips the entire station refining chain and wastes most of the ice — a lifeline for long-range explorers, but far too inefficient for industrial fuel production.

items.name: Onboard Hydrogen Refinery
items.description: A self-contained burner that passively converts hydrogen gas in the hold directly into tank fuel. It skips every refining intermediate and wastes most of the gas — invaluable for a deep-space explorer far from any fuel depot, but never worth it where a station is in reach.

items.name: Optical Fiber Bundle
items.description: Ultra-pure glass fibers for high-bandwidth data transfer.

items.name: Orchard Wine
items.description: Honest fruit wine, fermented from honeyglobe and bottled young. No pretensions, no pedigree, just a decent glass a station can make itself. The house pour from here to the Rim.

items.name: Ore Hopper
items.description: Specialized container for raw ore transport.

items.name: Osmium Armor Plate
items.description: Ultra-dense armor plating for maximum protection.

items.name: Osmium Ore
items.description: The densest naturally occurring element, used in specialized armor.

items.name: Outer Rim Salvage Array
items.description: Jury-rigged salvage system that extracts more from wrecks and debris.

items.name: Outer Rim Scrap Armor
items.description: Adds 15 armor and 50 maximum hull points and reduces speed by 1. While bracing below maximum hull, consumes 1 salvage item per tick to restore 10 hull.

items.name: Outpost Kit
items.description: A flat-packed deep-space outpost: a hardened lockbox, a fuel bladder, and the mooring spars to anchor them beside a landmark. Deploying one in lawless space plants a members-only faction outpost — a shared storage vault and fuel reserve, nothing more. Far less than a station, and far cheaper to field.

items.name: Overcharge Cell
items.description: High-voltage power cell for temporary weapon overcharging.

items.name: Overcharged Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Dangerously overcharged cells delivering massive thermal output. Handle with care.

items.name: Overclock Chip
items.description: Overclocks weapon-control processors, reducing weapon cooldowns by 10% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Oxygen Gas
items.description: Pure oxygen gas produced by electrolyzing water or processing oxygen ice. Combines with liquid hydrogen as a high-efficiency propellant.

items.name: Oxygen Ice
items.description: Solid oxygen for emergency life support reserves.

items.name: Palladium Ore
items.description: Rare earth element crucial for shield emitter arrays.

items.name: Pan-Galactic Matrix
items.description: Voidborn null matter, Solarian composite, and Nebula trade ciphers unified in a circuit lattice. The pinnacle of cross-empire cooperation, these matrices power the most advanced technology in known space.

items.name: Pathfinder Drive
items.description: An experimental long-range drive that abandons the jump-lane network entirely. With one installed you can plot a numeric compass bearing on the jump command instead of a system name, and the drive will push your ship across open space along that heading using raw galactic coordinates. It is agonizingly slow — far slower than a lane jump — and unforgiving: miss your mark and you keep drifting. Plot a new bearing mid-drift (each replot costs another 5x jump's fuel) to correct course; a 180-degree reversal heads back the way you came. If you run dry of fuel out there, self-destruct is your last way home.

items.name: PD Burst
items.description: Activates emergency point defense, reducing missile hit chance by 80% for 3 ticks.

items.name: Perception Enhancer
items.description: Increases scanner power by 50% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Pharmaceutical Culture
items.description: Standardized biological culture media from certified biotech labs. Used in consumer wellness products and industrial synthesis.

items.name: Phase Array
items.description: Phased optics for cloaking technology.

items.name: Phase Cloaking Device
items.description: Top-tier stealth system using phase technology.

items.name: Phase Crystal
items.description: Exists partially out of phase with normal space-time. Found only in Outer Rim exploration zones.

items.name: Phase Disruptor
items.description: Deals 48 void damage and ignores 30% of typed resistance. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Phase Drive
items.description: Allows ships to partially phase out of normal space.

items.name: Phase Matrix
items.description: Stabilized phase crystal for reality manipulation.

items.name: Phase Pearl
