items.description: A half-real bead grown by a phase-lurker, flickering in and out of sight as the phase-crystal it ate keeps trying to leave this universe.

items.name: Phased Void Core Pack
items.description: Phase-shifted cores that partially bypass shields and armor.

items.name: Piercing Railgun I
items.description: Deals 35 kinetic damage; 50% bypasses armor. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Piercing Railgun II
items.description: Deals 65 kinetic damage; 65% bypasses armor. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Pilot-Whale Chowder
items.description: Whale blubber rendered slow into a thick chowder with crystal-melt and greens. What cloud-whaling crews eat coming off a long haul, ladled by the potful and argued over for years after.

items.name: Pirate Moonshine
items.description: Distilled from water ice and pharmaceutical cultures in conditions that would make a health inspector weep. Every stronghold swears theirs is the best. They all share the same property: you won't remember what happened, and you won't want to.

items.name: Pirate Radio Scanner
items.description: A salvaged broadband receiver tuned to known pirate communication frequencies. Passively intercepts unencrypted pirate radio traffic within a few jumps. Having it installed is enough — no active use required.

items.name: Plasma Afterburner
items.description: Maximum speed enhancement.

items.name: Plasma Cannon I
items.description: Superheated plasma projectiles that burn through armor.

items.name: Plasma Cannon II
items.description: Enhanced plasma weapon with improved containment fields.

items.name: Plasma Cannon III
items.description: Deals 58 thermal damage and reduces armor effectiveness by 15% for 3 ticks on hit. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Cannon IV
items.description: Deals 85 thermal damage and reduces armor effectiveness by 30% for 3 ticks on hit. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Plasma Cell
items.description: Magnetically contained plasma for high-energy applications.

items.name: Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Pack of standard plasma cartridges. One pack fully loads any plasma weapon magazine.

items.name: Plasma Gas
items.description: Superheated ionized gas captured from stellar coronas.

items.name: Plasma Injector
items.description: Fuel injection system for plasma weapons.

items.name: Plasma Mines
items.description: Thermal detonation mines. Superheated blast melts armor in the vicinity.

items.name: Plasma Repeater I
items.description: Rapid-fire plasma weapon with lower damage per shot.

items.name: Plasma Repeater II
items.description: Advanced rapid-fire plasma system with improved heat dissipation.

items.name: Plasma Residue
items.description: High-energy plasma condensate harvested from Crimson weapons testing ranges.

items.name: Plasma Sinter
items.description: A still-warm brick of plasma residue re-fired in a fluxipede's gut segments into a stable, workable flux. Dropped into a titanium melt it does the plasma-flux step on its own, no raw residue or extra steel required. A ranch product.

items.name: Plasma Torpedo Launcher
items.description: Deals 60 thermal damage and reduces armor effectiveness by 20% for 3 ticks on hit. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Plasma Torpedoes
items.description: Superheated plasma warhead. Melts armor on impact and continues burning.

items.name: Platinum Bar
items.description: A dense, white-metal bar worth a small ship apiece. The serious collector's bullion — rarer than gold, useful for nothing, and a quiet way to say one has more credits than one knows what to do with.

items.name: Platinum Catalyst
items.description: Platinum refined into a high-surface-area catalytic sponge. A little of it makes a chemical reaction go where it otherwise would not — but industrial beds foul in service and demand steady replacement. The heart of catalytic fuel refining, fuel-cell assembly, polymer cracking, and air-scrubber cartridges.

items.name: Platinum Ore
items.description: Precious metal with excellent catalytic properties.

items.name: Platinum Wiring
items.description: Fine wire drawn from stubborn white metal. It conducts worse than gold and fights the die every gauge of the way, but the contacts and electrodes made from it never pit, tarnish, or erode.

items.name: Polonium Ore
items.description: Extremely radioactive element for compact power sources.

items.name: Power Battery
items.description: High-density lithium energy storage unit.

items.name: Power Cell
items.description: High-capacity energy storage unit.

items.name: Power Core
items.description: High-capacity energy cell for ship systems.

items.name: Power Distribution Grid
items.description: Ship-wide power routing network with redundant pathways and load balancing.

items.name: Power Reactor Upgrade
items.description: Adds additional power capacity.

items.name: Power Surge Cell
items.description: Discharges stored power through every fitted weapon, immediately resetting their cooldowns.

items.name: Precision Optic
items.description: Solarian composite ground into optical-grade lenses and mounted in glass housings. Essential for advanced targeting and sensor systems.

items.name: Premium Fuel Cell
items.description: High-density fuel cell, restores 50 fuel.

items.name: Pressure Seal
items.description: Airtight seal for hull penetrations and hatches.

items.name: Prism-Charged Cocktail
items.description: Gloomshine and honeyglobe spiked with prism-charged ichor, so the drink shifts through a whole spectrum as you tilt the glass. Ordered for the show, finished for the kick. A deep-galaxy status symbol.

items.name: Prism-Charged Ichor
items.description: Iridescent hemolymph wrung from a prism-drifter's mantle, dense with refracting nebulite motes the grazer concentrates from the clouds it strains. Only well-fed drifters in nebulite-rich clouds carry it. A key feedstock for pan-galactic alloy.

items.name: Prismatic Carapace
items.description: The spectacular molted shell of a Rainbow Leviathan, fracturing light into shifting bands of colour. Its lattice is laced with exotic metals concentrated across a lifetime of hunting exotic-fed fauna — the raw material for pan-galactic alloy.

items.name: Prismatic Lens
items.description: Light-refracting material for advanced targeting systems.

items.name: Prismatic Nebulite
items.description: Multicolored crystalline ore that refracts energy in unusual ways.

items.name: Processed Null Matter
items.description: Stabilized null matter for stealth technology.

items.name: Processed Thorium
items.description: Refined thorium for molten salt reactors and radiation sources.

items.name: Processing Core
items.description: Central computing unit for ship systems.

items.name: Promenade Lounge
items.description: A proper bar with a view — soft lighting, a stocked back-shelf, and enough room to make a long haul feel like part of the holiday. Serves drinks and spirits from cargo and keeps passengers relaxed enough to forgive a leisurely course.

items.name: Protein Rations
items.description: Cooked xeno-meat pressed and vacuum-sealed into dense ration blocks. Not fancy, but it's real meat and it keeps — the backbone of any frontier galley that can't source empire supply.

items.name: Proximity Mine Launcher
items.description: Deals 65 explosive damage from an 8-mine magazine; detection adds 10 hit-chance points, capped at 95% total. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 90 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 90) per tick.

items.name: Pulse Laser I
items.description: Entry-level energy weapon. Reliable but weak.

items.name: Pulse Laser II
items.description: Improved energy weapon with better focusing optics.

items.name: Pulse Laser III
items.description: Military-grade pulse laser with rapid fire capability.

items.name: Purified Argon
items.description: Inert gas for welding, shielding, and controlled atmospheres.

items.name: Purified Krypton
items.description: Ultra-pure krypton gas for precision optical systems and photon absorption cloaking technology.

items.name: Purified Water
items.description: Purified water for life support and chemical processing.

items.name: Purified Xenon
items.description: Dense noble gas for ion propulsion and high-intensity lighting.

items.name: Quantum Computer Core
items.description: Adds massive CPU capacity through quantum processing.

items.name: Quantum Control Core
items.description: A high-bandwidth coordination core for advanced fabrication — quantum-precise scheduling for the most demanding production work.

items.name: Quantum Dot Matrix
items.description: Nanoscale semiconductors for quantum computing.

items.name: Quantum Entanglement Shield
items.description: Adds 250 maximum shield points and 6 shield points to each regeneration tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Quantum Entangler
items.description: Quantum-linked communication device for instantaneous data transfer.

items.name: Quantum Fizz
items.description: A fruit soda spun with quantum-moth silk and biogas until it seems to fizz in several glasses at once. Tastes different to everyone, allegedly. Physicists hate the marketing; the bar doesn't care.

items.name: Quantum Fragments
items.description: Unstable particles that exist in multiple states simultaneously. Found only in Outer Rim frontier space.

items.name: Quantum Processor
items.description: Reality-defying computing unit for exotic ships.

items.name: Quantum Shield IV
items.description: Adds 250 maximum shield points and 35% flat/adaptive damage reduction. Flat and adaptive reductions add and cap at 75%, applied after typed resistance.

items.name: Quantum Silk
items.description: Thread spun by a quantum-moth from quantum fragments, each strand existing in several places at once. A spool of it is never quite where you put it.

items.name: Quantum Stabilizer
items.description: Voidborn null matter bonded to a circuit substrate. Stabilizes quantum states in sensitive equipment across the galaxy.

items.name: Rad Harvester I
items.description: A lead-lined mining module that allows safe extraction of radioactive ores.

items.name: Rad Harvester II
items.description: Enhanced rad harvester with improved shielding and isotope capture systems.

items.name: Rad Harvester III
items.description: Industrial-grade hot-isotope extraction with titanium shielding and superconducting beam emitters.

items.name: Rad Harvester IV
items.description: Capital-grade radiation mining system with full hot-cell containment and maximum yield.

items.name: Radiant Bile
items.description: Luminous, faintly warm fluid wrung from a cinder-urchin's gut. The radioisotopes it concentrates from uranium make it a potent — and hazardous — reactor primer.

items.name: Radiant-Glazed Ribs
items.description: Grazer ribs lacquered in a cinder-urchin radiant-bile glaze that genuinely, faintly glows. Perfectly safe. Almost certainly perfectly safe. The Outer Rim's favourite dare, and its favourite hangover cure.

items.name: Radiant Tonic
items.description: Crystal-melt, noble condensate, and a carefully small amount of cinder-urchin radiant bile, glowing an unwholesome green. Marketed as an energy tonic. Consumed as a dare. Regulated in three empires and beloved in the fourth.

items.name: Radiation-Hardened Circuit
items.description: Circuit board hardened with radium phosphor. Resistant to radiation damage and electromagnetic interference.

items.name: Radium Ore
items.description: Glowing radioactive element used in specialized equipment.

items.name: Radium Phosphor
items.description: Radioluminescent compound derived from radium ore. Used in specialized sensor and circuit applications.

items.name: Railgun Capacitor
items.description: High-energy capacitor bank for electromagnetic weapons.

items.name: Railgun I
items.description: Electromagnetic accelerator. High damage, slow fire.

items.name: Railgun II
items.description: Deals 55 kinetic damage; 50% bypasses armor. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Rainbow Leviathan Carpaccio
items.description: Rainbow Leviathan flesh sliced tissue-thin and cured just enough to keep the starlight shimmer, dressed with lumen oil and a sour ember-cure. The single rarest plate in the galaxy — most chefs will go a whole career without the chance to ruin it once.

items.name: Rainbow Leviathan Flesh
items.description: Flesh from the grandest of the void-leviathans, shot through with the same starlight-fracturing pigment as its shell — it shifts colour as you turn the cut. Impossibly rare, faintly sweet, and served raw so the shimmer survives to the plate. Chefs who have worked it can be counted on one hand.

items.name: Rancher's Breakfast
items.description: Two ray eggs fried in whale oil over a pile of grilled xeno-meat and gloomcap hash. What the corral crew eats before the first feed run of the shift — big, hot, and unapologetic.

items.name: Rare Salvage
items.description: Exotic materials and advanced components from high-value wrecks.

items.name: Raw Focusing Crystal
items.description: A cloudy, self-grown crystal lattice cut from the gut-geode of a tended druse, seeded by the crystal it filters and left to accrete in the calm of a ranch. Rough and unfocused, but already halfway to a weapon core — a bench cuts it straight down to a focused crystal, skipping the raw-crystal grind. Ranch-only: a hunted druse shatters its geode to gravel.

items.name: Raw Xeno-Meat
items.description: Butchered muscle from a space grazer — dense, dark, faintly iridescent. Edible once cooked, and a galley kitchen can turn it into ration blocks or a proper smoked delicacy. Won't keep long unrefrigerated.

items.name: Ray Eggs
items.description: Leathery, palm-sized egg cases collected from a tended ranch-ray shoal, each holding a rich amber yolk. Rays only lay in the calm of a ranch — a hunted ray takes its clutch with it.

items.name: Reactive Armor Hardener
items.description: Adds 60% resistance to the incoming damage type. Typed and reactive module resistances add and cap at 75%; resistance bypass reduces that total.

items.name: Reactor Fuel Assembly
items.description: Sealed fuel rod assembly for nuclear fission reactors. Primary input for plutonium breeding.

items.name: Reactor-Grade Plutonium
items.description: Plutonium bred in a fission reactor. Requires further refinement for weapons applications.

items.name: Reconnaissance Probe
items.description: Standard probe that increases scanner power by 20% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Red Mist
items.description: A pre-loaded injector of synthetic adrenaline and neural accelerants. Popular with boarding parties. Everything goes red, everything slows down, and you stop caring about the odds. Side effects include nosebleeds, short-term memory gaps, and an overwhelming urge to do it again.

items.name: Refined Plasma Core
items.description: Stabilized high-energy plasma for weapon systems.

items.name: Refined Quantum Matrix
items.description: Processed quantum-entangled material for advanced tech.

items.name: Reflex Enhancer
items.description: Improves evasion by 15% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Refractory Sinter
items.description: A knuckle of iridium and thorium fused in a vulcanid's gut into a nugget that laughs at a foundry — already alloyed, already dense, needing only silicon to bond it into a composite. Recovered from a hunted vulcanid; the belt has no other source.

items.name: Refueling Pump
items.description: A high-pressure fuel transfer system that allows you to pump fuel from your own tank to another ship at the same location. Essential equipment for tankers and rescue operations.

items.name: Regeneration Serum
items.description: Bio-nanite serum that accelerates hull self-repair.

items.name: Regenerative Armor I
items.description: Adds 20 armor and 40 current and maximum hull points, and repairs 2 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Regenerative Armor II
items.description: Adds 40 armor and 80 current and maximum hull points, and repairs 5 hull points each tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses and repair.

items.name: Regenerative Compound
items.description: Bio-synthetic repair material. Restores 30 hull/tick for 10 ticks.

items.name: Reinforced Bulkhead
items.description: Heavy structural framing that distributes stress across multiple hull sections. Standard in warships and heavy haulers.

items.name: Reinforced Frame
items.description: A heavy durasteel-and-composite skeleton braced for high-stress industry — capital shipbuilding, heavy weapons fabrication, and the largest production lines.

items.name: Reinforced Glass
items.description: Transparent armor for viewports and sensors.

items.name: Relic Amber
items.description: A clear amber secreted over a relict's ancient shell, dense with legacy-ore laid down grain by grain across a lifetime nobody has measured. Smelts straight to legacy alloy. Recovered from a hunted specimen — the xenobiologists weep.

items.name: Remote Armor Repairer I
items.description: Repairs armor on allied ships.

items.name: Remote Armor Repairer II
items.description: Enhanced remote repair capability.

items.name: Remote Armor Repairer III
items.description: Capital-class remote repair for fleet support.

items.name: Repair Arm
items.description: A remote hull repair system that allows you to patch another ship's hull using repair kits from your cargo. Essential equipment for fleet support ships.

items.name: Repair Drone
items.description: Autonomous repair drone for field repairs.

items.name: Repair Kit
items.description: Emergency repair kit. Restores 50 hull when used as a consumable, or repairs module wear when used with the repair_module command at a base with repair service.

items.name: Repair Nanite Container
items.description: Contained micro-robots for hull repair.

items.name: Repair Nanites
items.description: Self-replicating nanobots for automated hull repair.

items.name: Rhodium Coating
items.description: An ultra-reflective, heat-resistant rhodium finish for precision optics and electrical contacts.

items.name: Rhodium Optic Array
items.description: Focused crystal optics with a heat-resistant rhodium mirror coating for precision sensors and beam control.

items.name: Rhodium Ore
items.description: Ultra-reflective metal for advanced optical systems.

items.name: Rime Fang
items.description: A frost-sheathed fang from a frost-lurker, cold enough to burn. Cutters mount them as blades that never need sharpening.

items.name: Rime Milk
items.description: Thick, near-frozen milk from ranched rime-grazers, loaded with the antifreeze fats that keep the animal alive on the ice. It pours slow, keeps forever, and cultures into a blue cheese people cross systems for.

items.name: Rimeblue Cheese
items.description: A veined blue cheese set from rime milk and cellared with gloomcap culture until the cold-blue mold runs through it. Sharp, creamy, and faintly frosted even at room temperature. The pride of the ice-field ranches.

items.name: Rivetshell Meat
items.description: The sweet, briny muscle pried from a farmed rivetshell, sold live in the shell or shucked by the crate. Cooks fast, soaks up whatever it's cooked in, and turns a belt outpost's galley into somewhere worth docking for. A ranch product — wild reefs keep their meat.

items.name: Salvage Components
items.description: Partially intact ship systems recovered from wrecks.

items.name: Salvage Drone
items.description: Automated salvage drone for wreck processing.

items.name: Salvage Enhancer
items.description: +50% salvage yield for 20 ticks.

items.name: Salvage Metal
items.description: Reclaimed metal from ship hulls. Used in manufacturing and repairs.

items.name: Salvage Module
items.description: Extracts valuable components from wrecks.

items.name: Scout Drone
items.description: Long-range reconnaissance drone with enhanced sensors.

items.name: Scrap Harpoon
items.description: Deals 44 kinetic damage; 30% bypasses armor. Uses no ammunition and fires every 3 ticks at reach 2.

items.name: Scrap Missiles
items.description: A salvaged seeker head, a length of pipe, and as much of somebody else's fuel as would fit. The guidance is enthusiastic rather than accurate. Fired in enough quantity this stops mattering, which is the entire pirate theory of ordnance.

items.name: Scrap Rounds
items.description: Hand-loaded cartridges of indifferent quality, filled from a barrel of powder somebody swears is the right powder. They will feed through an autocannon, mostly, and the ones that do not are cleared with a hammer.

items.name: Scrap Shot
items.description: Whatever was lying about, cut to something near the right diameter and packed into a case by hand. It fouls the barrel, it scatters, and roughly one round in twenty is a rock. It is also free, it is made out of the wreck of the last people who came calling, and there is a very great deal of it.

items.name: Scrap Torpedoes
items.description: A warhead cut out of something that did not need it any more, welded to a drive taken off something that did. Slow, ugly, and carrying a great deal of explosive toward a station that cannot dodge. Against anything that can, they are a waste of a good warhead.

items.name: Scrapgun
items.description: Deals 30 kinetic damage. Reloading consumes any 1 cargo item to fill its 500-round magazine; omitting the item selects low-value cargo. Fires every tick at reach 2.

items.name: Seared Glintfin
items.description: A whole glintfin fillet hit hard in a screaming pan of whale oil, crisped at the edges and barely set through, laid over griddled sunspindle. Simple, fast, and the first thing every belt cook learns to do with a fish once they've finally got one.

items.name: Secure Vault
items.description: Reinforced storage for valuable cargo.

items.name: Sensor Array
items.description: Multi-spectrum detection equipment.

items.name: Sensor Booster
items.description: Increases scanner power by 50% for 5 ticks.

items.name: Sensor Cluster
items.description: Multi-spectrum sensor package with cross-referencing analysis cores.

items.name: Sensor Dampener
items.description: Reduces enemy targeting range and scan resolution.

items.name: Sensor Package
items.description: Integrated sensor and diagnostic array for hull scanning and system analysis.

items.name: Shaped Charge Slug Case
items.description: Explosive-lined slugs that focus blast energy through the target hull on impact.

items.name: Shield Array
items.description: Linked bank of shield emitters that shares load across overlapping fields.

items.name: Shield Booster I
items.description: Adds 25 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster II
items.description: Adds 50 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster III
items.description: Adds 100 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster IV
items.description: Adds 200 maximum shield points. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Booster MK2
items.description: Advanced shield restoration. Restores 200 shields.

items.name: Shield Charge
items.description: Instant shield restoration, restores 100 shields.

items.name: Shield Emitter
items.description: Projector unit for defensive shields.

items.name: Shield Generator
items.description: Large-scale shield projector for stations and capitals.

items.name: Shield Hardener
items.description: Increases shield resistance by 25% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Shield Matrix
items.description: Energy distribution matrix for advanced shield systems.

items.name: Shield Overcharge
items.description: Overcharges shields to 150% capacity for 10 ticks.

items.name: Shield Recharger I
items.description: Adds 2 shield points to each regeneration tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Recharger II
items.description: Adds 5 shield points to each regeneration tick. Multiple copies add their bonuses.

items.name: Shield Regenerator
items.description: Boosts shield recharge rate by 50% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Ship Maintenance Bay
items.description: Allows refitting and repairs in space.

items.name: Ship Scanner I
items.description: Scans other ships for information.

items.name: Ship Scanner II
items.description: Enhanced scanning resolution.

items.name: Ship Scanner III
items.description: Military-grade intelligence gathering.

items.name: Siege Railgun
items.description: Deals 120 kinetic damage; 80% bypasses armor. Fires every 4 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Siege Torpedoes
items.description: Maximum hull damage payload. Designed for breaking stations and capital ships.

items.name: Silica Lens
items.description: A flawless disc of fused silica, ground smooth in the gizzard of a silica-borer. The surface uniformity is biological — no grinding machine produces the same result.

items.name: Silicate Composite
items.description: Advanced semiconductor substrate for computing systems.

items.name: Silicon Ore
items.description: Semiconductor base material for computing components.

items.name: Silver Bar
items.description: A heavy bar of pure silver, cool and faintly luminous. It does no work and fits no machine — wealth worn on the sleeve, for pilots who would rather see their fortune than read it off a balance.

items.name: Silver Ore
items.description: Reflective metal with antimicrobial properties.

items.name: Silver Wiring
items.description: High-conductivity silver wiring for precision electronics and shield systems.

items.name: Singularity Core
items.description: Micro black hole power source. Extremely dangerous.

items.name: Singularity Core Pack
items.description: Contains stabilized micro-singularity charges. The most destructive ammunition in known space.

items.name: Singularity Plate
items.description: Event-horizon alloy beaten flat over a darksteel-and-fury backing into a finished plate — impossibly dense, and lighter to carry than it has any right to be. The core of the toughest hull armor ever fielded. There is no ore route to it: it begins as something a black hole grew a coral to make.

items.name: Singularity Slug Case
items.description: Experimental slugs containing stabilized micro-singularities. Warps space around the impact point.

items.name: Smoke Screen
items.description: A conductive particulate cloud that reduces enemy accuracy by 40% for 3 ticks.

items.name: Smoked Xeno Delicacy
items.description: Xeno-meat cured and cold-smoked with fermentation cultures over a long aging cycle. Rich, complex, and prized on tasting menus — the kind of centerpiece that makes a dining room's reputation.

items.name: Sol Alloy Ore
items.description: Ancient alloy deposits from Sol's asteroid belt, prized for their purity.

items.name: Sol Nacre
items.description: Sheets of gold-throwing nacre peeled from a coronid's carapace, sol-alloy laid down in an organic lattice the Confederacy prizes for its composite. Skips the ore-and-steel forge. Taken from a hunted crab.

items.name: Solar Collector Array
items.description: Photonic energy harvesting system calibrated to multiple stellar classifications.

items.name: Solar Lance
items.description: Deals 65 energy damage with a 25% energy-damage bonus. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Solar Panel Array
items.description: Photovoltaic power generation for stations.

items.name: Solarian Aegis
items.description: Adds 100 maximum shield points and returns 20% of final incoming energy damage as EM damage. Reflection percentages add and cap at 75%.

items.name: Solarian Biotic
items.description: Solarian Biotech Division certified wellness supplement. Whether they work better than alternatives is hotly debated. They cost more. That is the point.

items.name: Solarian Composite
items.description: Advanced material developed in Sol system research labs.

items.name: Solarian Gourmet Rations
items.description: Vacuum-sealed meals prepared in Sol Central's hydroponic biosphere. Real food is a luxury in space, and nobody does it better than the Confederacy.

items.name: Solarian Legacy Alloy
items.description: A refined alloy made from ancient Solarian Legacy ore. Its unique crystalline structure makes it exceptionally resistant to energy weapons.

items.name: Solarian Logic Matrix
items.description: Quantum-coherent processor array. Three peer review committees certified its clock speed.

items.name: Space Pizza
items.description: A hand-stretched sunspindle crust under ember marinara, molten beltwheel cheese, and a scatter of seared xeno-meat, fired hot and cut into slices you can eat one-handed on a moving deck. The galaxy argued about toppings for about a week and then just kept ordering it.

items.name: Speed Stim
items.description: Increases ship speed by 25% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Spore Ragout
items.description: Gloomcap mash braised down with driftkale and a spoon of whale oil into something deep and savoury. The best argument the frontier has that you don't need meat to eat well — not that anyone asked.

items.name: Stabilized Exotic
items.description: Exotic matter processed into usable form.

items.name: Stainless Alloy Plate
items.description: Chromium-rich structural steel hardened with ferromanganese for corrosion-resistant hull and shield assemblies.

items.name: Standard Guided Missiles
items.description: Heat-seeking guided missiles. Reliable all-purpose ordnance.

items.name: Standard Mines
items.description: Basic proximity-detonated explosives for area denial.

items.name: Standard Rounds Box
items.description: Crate of basic kinetic autocannon ammunition. One box fully loads any autocannon magazine.

items.name: Standard Torpedoes
items.description: Heavy anti-capital torpedoes. Slow but devastating on impact.

items.name: Starshine
items.description: Pirate moonshine filtered through crushed energy crystals. The crystalline infusion gives it an otherworldly glow and a taste that's been described as 'the aurora borealis in a glass.' The only pirate product that some empire citizens will quietly admit to seeking out.

items.name: Stasis Webifier I
items.description: Slows target ship's velocity.

items.name: Stasis Webifier II
items.description: Enhanced stasis field for better target control.

items.name: Station Core
items.description: The structural and command heart of a deep-space station: pressurized habitat ring, docking spine, command deck, and the integrated reactor that anchors everything else. Deploying one in lawless space founds a faction station that the owning faction must then build out and keep supplied.

items.name: Station Lager
items.description: A clean, cold sunspindle lager brewed in-station and drunk by the crate. Not one bottle has ever changed a life, and that is exactly the point. The most-poured drink in the galaxy, bar none.

items.name: Station Reactor
items.description: High-output fusion reactor core for station power generation.

items.name: Station Reactor Core
items.description: Large-scale power generation system for stations.

items.name: Steamed Rivetshell
items.description: A heaped pot of rivetshell steamed open over gloomcap broth and finished with a fistful of cinderspice, served with the shells still clacking. Communal, messy, and gone in minutes — the standard order for a whole dock crew coming off shift.

items.name: Steel Plate
items.description: Processed steel alloy for structural components.

items.name: Stellar Observation Deck
items.description: A domed leisure deck built around a panoramic viewport — cocktail bar, lounge seating, and the galaxy drifting past outside. The reason certain passengers book the slow ship on purpose. Serves alcohol and drink from cargo and makes even a multi-week crossing something to savor.

items.name: Stellar Plasma Cell Pack
items.description: Cells containing plasma harvested from stellar coronas. Burns hotter than any synthetic alternative.

items.name: Storm Lance
items.description: Deals 40 EM damage, then repeats its full final damage against up to 2 other enemies in the target's zone. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Storm Node
items.description: The crackling electric organ of a tempest-eel, still arcing faintly after harvest. A natural capacitor of frightening capacity.

items.name: Strip Miner I
items.description: Massive mining system that extracts entire asteroid chunks. Maximizes yield on common ore deposits but cannot selectively extract rarer veins. Coarse beam — needs dense deposits and cannot get a lock on heavily depleted ones.

items.name: Strip Miner II
items.description: Industrial mega-miner for maximum ore extraction. Maximizes yield on common ore deposits but cannot selectively extract rarer veins. Coarse beam — needs dense deposits and cannot get a lock on heavily depleted ones.

items.name: Structural Cement
items.description: Heavy-duty hull repair compound. Restores 200 hull.

items.name: Structural Frame
items.description: A prefabricated girder skeleton with integrated plumbing runs. The basic load-bearing shell every facility is built around.

items.name: Sunspindle
items.description: Spindly cereal grown in tall lamp-lit stalks and fed on nitrogen mist. Mills to flour, boils to mash, or steams as a side — the flour, noodle, and bread of half the galaxy starts here.

items.name: Superconductor
items.description: Zero-resistance conductor for shield systems.

items.name: Superfluid Caviar
items.description: Frost-moth superfluid spherified into weightless beads that burst cold on the tongue, crowning a scrape of rainbow-leviathan flesh. Molecular theatre for people who've eaten everything else — and can prove it.

items.name: Superfluid Martini
items.description: Cut with a drop of frost-moth superfluid, it crawls up the sides of the glass and never once warms in your hand. Insufferable people order it to explain the physics. It is, admittedly, a very good martini.

items.name: Superfluid Vial
items.description: A self-sealing bladder of frictionless helium superfluid, secreted by a frost-moth. Creeps up the walls of any container — cryo-labs cannot get enough.

items.name: Surf-and-Turf Platter
items.description: Crusher-mantis claw and a grazer steak on one board with a pile of greens. The classic 'I finally made some credits' order — equal parts hunter's brag and comfort food.

items.name: Survey Scanner I
items.description: Analyzes asteroids to find the richest ore deposits.

items.name: Survey Scanner II
items.description: Advanced geological analysis for optimal mining.

items.name: Sustagel
items.description: Grey, complete, and utterly joyless. Extruded from water and nitrogen feedstock into a shelf-stable ration gel that keeps a crew alive and asks only that they never look forward to a meal again. Every cadet knows the tube by heart.

items.name: Sustagel Bowl
items.description: Sustagel, warmed, with some driftkale stirred through it so a recruit can pretend. It is food in the strictest technical sense. Every spacer has a story about the day they finally stopped having to eat it.

items.name: Swarm Controller
items.description: Master control unit for coordinating drone swarms.

items.name: Swarm Missiles
items.description: Pod of micro-missiles that saturate the target area. Harder to evade but less damage per warhead.

items.name: Synthetic Compound
items.description: Synthetic organic base material for biological processing.

items.name: Synthetic Diamond
items.description: Lab-grown diamond for cutting tools and heat sinks.

items.name: System Disabler
items.description: Deals 2 EM damage and automatically disables the target's fitted weapon with the highest base damage for 1 tick. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Tactical Probe
items.description: Tactical probe that increases scanner power by 40% for 10 ticks.

items.name: Target Painter I
items.description: Marks target, increasing damage taken from all sources.

items.name: Target Painter II
items.description: Advanced targeting system with stronger signature amplification.

items.name: Targeting Computer
items.description: Advanced fire control system for improved weapon accuracy.

items.name: Temporal Stabilizer
items.description: Prevents time dilation effects during high-speed travel.

items.name: Thermal Ceramic
items.description: Heat-resistant material for engine and weapon components.

items.name: Thermal Hull Hardener
items.description: Adds 30% thermal resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Thermal Shield Hardener
items.description: Adds 25% thermal resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Thermal Smartbomb
items.description: Deals 38 thermal damage. AOE radius 5 sends the primary hit's full post-defense damage as a new hit to every other enemy within ZoneDistance 5 of the target; each applies its own defenses.

items.name: Thermal Sublimator
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of water ice into cargo. Use this to filter out water ice while targeting rarer isotope ices. Heats the intake to just above water's sublimation point — water flashes to vapor and vents; deuterium and helium ices pass through.

items.name: Thorium Concentrate
items.description: Refined thorium oxide extracted from raw ore. First step in thorium fuel processing.

items.name: Thorium Fuel Rod
items.description: Processed thorium fuel for molten-salt reactors and breeder blankets.

items.name: Thorium Ore
items.description: Fertile radioactive material for breeder reactors.

items.name: Threat Analyzer
items.description: Combat computer that prioritizes hostile targets.

items.name: Thruster Assembly
items.description: Integrated propulsion unit combining multiple nozzles with a coordinated burn controller.

items.name: Thruster Nozzle
items.description: Exhaust component for sublight propulsion.

items.name: Tide-Line Platter
items.description: The raw-bar showpiece: fanned glintfin, chilled rivetshell on the half-shell, and a cracked mantis claw over shaved ice with driftkale and three sharp sauces. Half surf, half spectacle — ordered for the table and photographed before anyone touches it.

items.name: Titanium Alloy
items.description: Advanced hull plating material.

items.name: Titanium Foam
items.description: Lightweight titanium structure with internal voids. Excellent strength-to-weight.

items.name: Titanium Ingot
items.description: Purified titanium for advanced structural applications.

items.name: Titanium Ore
items.description: Lightweight and incredibly strong, prized for ship hulls.

items.name: Trace Exotic Element
items.description: Rare element distilled from nebula gases. Used in stimulant synthesis.

items.name: Tracking Computer I
items.description: Improves weapon tracking speed and accuracy.

items.name: Tracking Computer II
items.description: Enhanced tracking system for hitting fast targets.

items.name: Tracking Computer III
items.description: Military-grade tracking for perfect weapon alignment.

items.name: Tracking Mine Launcher
items.description: Deals 100 explosive damage from a 5-mine magazine; tracking adds 3 hit-chance points, capped at 95% total. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 60 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 60) per tick.

items.name: Tracking System
items.description: Target acquisition and tracking hardware.

items.name: Tractor Beam
items.description: Short-range tackle and towing beam that slows a target, disrupts warp, and stabilizes towed ships.

items.name: Trade Authenticator
items.description: Nebula trade ciphers embedded in copper-wire contact arrays. Provides tamper-proof transaction verification for high-value exchanges, and trades at the Grand Exchange as a bearer instrument pegged by the Federation Treasury.

items.name: Trade Cipher
items.description: Cryptographic verification chip refined from Haven trade crystals. Every exchange in the galaxy depends on these to authenticate transactions and set prices.

items.name: Trade Crystal
items.description: Rare crystalline formation used as currency backing in Nebula Federation space.

items.name: Tritium Ice
items.description: Radioactive hydrogen isotope ice for high-yield fusion.

items.name: Tritium Pearl
items.description: The rarest pearl a glacier-drifter grows — supercooled tritium locked in a frozen shell grown over years of slow accumulation. One per animal. One animal per decade of patient hunting.

items.name: Tungsten Nugget
items.description: A dense carbide bead precipitated inside a kiln-snail's gland, harder than the rock it came from. Already worked harder than any industrial press achieves — needs only to be drawn into rod stock.

items.name: Tungsten Ore
items.description: Extremely hard metal with the highest melting point of any element.

items.name: Tungsten Rod
items.description: Dense penetrator material for kinetic weapons.

items.name: Tungsten Slug Case
items.description: Heavy tungsten penetrators in a reinforced case. Punches through heavy armor plating.

items.name: Turtle Compound
items.description: +40% defense, -25% speed for 15 ticks. Maximum survivability.

items.name: Umbral Residue
items.description: A blot of cold darkness left where an umbral-leech digested dark-matter residue. It drinks light, and laboratories drink it down just as fast.

items.name: Umbral Stout
items.description: A stout so dark with umbral-leech residue it seems to drink the light off the bar. Thick, roasty, and faintly unsettling to look at head-on. Nebula deep-runners age it in the hold for the long hauls.

items.name: Universal Nav Core
items.description: Nebula trade ciphers and Outer Rim dark matter integrated with circuit boards. Enables navigation across all known space without empire-specific transponder locks.

items.name: Uranium Concentrate
items.description: Yellowcake: crude uranium oxide extracted from ore. First step in the enrichment process.

items.name: Uranium Hexafluoride
items.description: UF6 gas: volatile uranium compound used in gaseous diffusion enrichment. Extremely hazardous.

items.name: Uranium Ore
items.description: Radioactive heavy metal for fission reactors and weapons.

items.name: Vanadium Ejector
items.description: When mining, prevents collection of vanadium ore into cargo. Use this to filter out vanadium while targeting rarer co-located resources. A tuned eddy-current separator catches the dense paramagnetic ore mid-stream and flings it clear of the intake. High power draw.

items.name: Vanadium Ore
items.description: Hard transition metal used in high-strength steel alloys.

items.name: Vat Protein Loaf
items.description: Vatflesh curd bound with sunspindle flour, spiced, and baked into a sliceable loaf. The honest workhorse of frontier canteens — cheap, filling, and genuinely decent once someone who cares gets hold of the cinderspice.

items.name: Vatflesh Curd
items.description: Cultured protein set into a firm pale curd. The frontier's answer to a butcher it doesn't have — bland alone, but it takes a marinade and a hot pan like nothing else, and no animal was inconvenienced.

items.name: Verdigris Curd
items.description: Blue-green copper paste scraped from a veil-ray's filtering combs. A ready feedstock for wiring and pigment.

items.name: Verdigris Kefir
items.description: A tangy cultured drink set from veil-ray verdigris curd, a faint copper-blue and sharper than it looks. Frontier medics push it on anyone whose gut has been living on ration blocks too long.

items.name: Void Cannon
items.description: Deals 75 void damage and ignores 50% of typed resistance. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 3.

items.name: Void Capacitor
items.description: Stores energy from void space dimensions.

items.name: Void-Charged Ichor
items.description: Black, faintly humming hemolymph drawn from a void-browser, saturated with the void-essence it chews from the deep fields. Only well-fed browsers in void-essence belts carry it. A key feedstock for pan-galactic alloy.

items.name: Void Condensate
items.description: Processed void essence in stable form.

items.name: Void Core Pack
items.description: Pack of standard void energy cores. One pack fully loads any void weapon magazine.

items.name: Void Crystal
items.description: Legendary material formed in the depths of space-time anomalies.

items.name: Void Dust
items.description: A fine iridescent powder derived from nebular gas processed through gutter flux. Inhaled or dissolved in liquid, it produces vivid hallucinations of drifting through open space. Highly addictive. Banned in all empire territories.

items.name: Void Espresso
items.description: Spore-mash coffee pulled short and dosed with void-charged ichor, so the crema glows and the caffeine hits like a jump drive. Deep-galaxy prospectors run on it. Nobody sleeps well, but the ore gets mined.

items.name: Void Essence
items.description: Crystallized vacuum energy harvested from spatial anomalies. Exclusive to Voidborn territory.

items.name: Void Hull Hardener
items.description: Adds 20% void resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Void Ichor
items.description: Viscous, faintly luminous hemolymph drawn from large void-dwelling predators. Volatile and energy-dense — it oxidizes on exposure and must be sealed in inert canisters or it degrades within hours.

items.name: Void-Ichor Consomme
items.description: A crystal-clear broth clarified with crystal-melt and laced with a thread of void ichor, so the whole bowl holds a faint blue glow you can read a menu by. Voidborn tasting rooms serve it in the dark, on purpose.

items.name: Void-Ichor Liqueur
items.description: Gloomshine cut with a measured dose of void ichor until the glass glows and the room goes quiet. Voidborn drink it neat; everyone else drinks it once. Sealed tight — it oxidises if you dawdle.

items.name: Void Lance I
items.description: Deals 55 void damage and ignores 50% of typed resistance. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Void Lance II
items.description: Deals 85 void damage and ignores 75% of typed resistance. Fires every 3 ticks at reach 4.

items.name: Void Laser
items.description: Deals 65 energy damage; 50% bypasses shields. Fires every 2 ticks at reach 5.

items.name: Void Mine Launcher
items.description: Deals 120 void damage from a 4-mine magazine and ignores 50% of typed resistance. On hit, also burns hull through shields and armor for 90 ticks at max(1, final hit damage / 90) per tick.

items.name: Void Mines
items.description: Creates a dimensional rift on detonation. Bypasses conventional shields.

items.name: Void Nanite Suspension
items.description: The Collective produces these in facilities it declines to describe using processes it refuses to classify. The output is called a suspension. Of what is not specified.

items.name: Void Reactor
items.description: Generates power from void energy.

items.name: Void Shield Hardener
items.description: Adds 20% void resistance. Typed module resistances add and cap at 75%, then flat/adaptive reduction applies as the next damage stage.

items.name: Void Shield Matrix
items.description: Voidborn null matter woven through Crimson fury alloy and crystal lattice. Creates a defensive barrier that absorbs both physical and dimensional attacks.

items.name: Void Torpedo Launcher
items.description: Deals 100 void damage and ignores 75% of typed resistance. Fires every 5 ticks at reach 6.

items.name: Void-Tuned EM Charge Pack
items.description: EM charges calibrated using void crystal harmonics. Bypasses conventional EM shielding.

items.name: Voidborn Neural Matrix
items.description: Quantum computing substrate grown in null-energy fields. For the Voidborn, these are art. For everyone else, they're the most powerful processors money can buy.

items.name: Voidborn Neural Soma
items.description: Not exactly food. Not exactly software. The Collective considers the distinction an oversimplification. It is consumed. That is all they will say.

items.name: Voidborn Null Matrix
items.description: Void energy focusing lattice. The mathematics describing its operation have no solution.

items.name: Voidborn Phase Armor
items.description: Adds 30 armor and 80 maximum hull points, and reduces enemy hit chance by 25%. Phase-dodge percentages add and cap at 75%.

items.name: Voidborn Phase Drive
items.description: Propulsion system that partially shifts the hull between dimensional states to reduce inertia.

items.name: Warhead Assembly
items.description: Explosive warhead core for missile fabrication.

items.name: Warp Core
items.description: Advanced faster-than-light propulsion core.

items.name: Warp Core Stabilizer
items.description: Resists warp disruption effects.

items.name: Warp Disruptor
items.description: Long-range warp prevention module.

items.name: Warp Scrambler
items.description: Prevents target from jumping to hyperspace.

items.name: Warp Stabilizer
items.description: Prevents warp disruption for 5 ticks.

items.name: Water Ice
items.description: Frozen water extracted from comets and ice moons. Essential for life support.

items.name: Water Recycler
items.description: Closed-loop water purification system.

items.name: Weapon Battery
items.description: Hardened weapon platform housing multiple firing mechanisms with shared targeting.

items.name: Weapon Core
items.description: Central power and control unit for weapon systems.

items.name: Weapon Housing
items.description: Mounting bracket and power conduit for weapons.

items.name: Weapon Overload Capacitor
items.description: Dumps stored energy into weapons for a burst of extra damage.

items.name: Weapons-Grade Plutonium
items.description: Refined fissile material for warheads and advanced reactors.

items.name: Whale Baleen
items.description: A curved plate of living keratin from a Cloudwhale's filter-mouth — meters long, lighter than steel and tougher than it has any right to be. The whale grows them as armor as much as a sieve; shipwrights cut them down into capital-grade plating that no foundry can match for weight.

items.name: Whale Blubber
items.description: Thick oil-rich fat rendered from cloud-grazing whales. Cheaper cousin to the industrial whale-oil trade — but rendered slow in a galley it's the backbone of every good chowder and confit from here to the Rim.

items.name: Whale-Blubber Confit
items.description: Grazer meat cooked down slow and sealed under rendered whale blubber, spiced and left to keep. Half a preserve, half a delicacy — the flavour a dock cook builds a reputation on.

items.name: Whale Oil
items.description: Energy-dense blubber oil flensed from a pilot-whale pod — thick, slow-burning, and packed with the charge the whales strain out of the argon banks. The staple of every cloud-whaling crew: render it down and it sets straight into power cells, the living counterpart to the argon synthesis line.

items.name: Whale-Oil Grog
items.description: Rough gloomshine, honeyglobe, and a controversial float of whale oil, served hot. Cloud-whaling crews swear it keeps the cold out; landlubbers swear at it. An acquired everything.

items.name: Wiring Harness
items.description: Pre-assembled electrical wiring bundle for ship systems.

items.name: Xenon Gas
items.description: Noble gas used in advanced ion thrusters and lighting.

items.name: Zinc Ingot
items.description: Refined zinc for corrosion-resistant coatings and alloy production.

items.name: Zinc Ore
items.description: Corrosion-resistant metal for protective coatings.
